builderSkills.name: Psi Reap

builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battles Vurk sets poison traps behind himself and his frontline allies. builderSkills.desc: The iron-jaw assists Skreg in attacking his enemies by smashing them backwards into the air, dealing a small amount of damage to them. builderSkills.name: Ironskin
builderSkills.desc: Enemies deal less damage to Skreg the closer they get to him. Damage reduction is at its maximum when enemies are within Skreg's striking range. Damage received can be reduced by up to 40%.

builderSkills.name: Stampede
builderSkills.desc: Every 8 seconds an iron-jaw appears and charges towards the enemy closest to Skreg's allies' side of the battlefield, knocking them and any other enemies in its path, dealing 150% damage to them.

sigItem.name: Beast Rider
sigItem.desc: The ability "Beast of Burden" will no longer drain Energy for the first 5 seconds after each time it is used.

builderSkills.desc: Thane attacks his enemies at random 7 times, dealing 80% damage per attack. Thane cannot receive damage while using this skill.

builderSkills.name: Lunge
builderSkills.desc: Thane bounds towards an enemy with a surprise attack, dealing 120% damage to them. Thane's Crit Rating is also raised by 20% for a duration of 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Execution
builderSkills.desc: Activated after Thane uses 4 critical strikes. Thane targets a single enemy with a multi-stage attack with the final attack dealing 80% damage. The final attack also deals an additional damage which is equal to 15% of the target's max HP.

builderSkills.name: Focus
builderSkills.desc: Thane raises his own Crit Rating by 14%.

sigItem.name: Finesse
sigItem.desc: Thane's damage is increased by 20% if he does not receive damage for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Abhorrent Torrent
builderSkills.desc: Seirus sends several large waves surging towards his enemies, dealing 70% damage per wave. Each wave knocks the enemies backwards and stuns them.

builderSkills.name: Deluge
builderSkills.desc: Seirus calls up on the ocean's power by summoning large columns of water that erupt at the nearest 2 enemies' feet. The columns of water cause 120% AoE damage to nearby enemies and become larger and more powerful, the closer they are standing to Seirus.

builderSkills.name: Free Flow
builderSkills.desc: Damage that is less than 7% of Seirus' maximum health is reduced by 50%.

sigItem.name: Sea Lord
sigItem.desc: At the beginning of battles Seirus will cause his own max health to increase by 40%, however his current health after the increase will not be at maximum unless restored.

builderSkills.name: Fury Strike
builderSkills.desc: Antandra unleashes a multi-stage attack that deals 50% damage with each hit to the enemy which currently has the highest Attack Rating, with the final attack dealing 190% damage to them, also stunning them for 3 seconds. While this ability is in use, Antandra is immune to damage and ignores the enemy's dodges. After successfully striking the enemy with her final attack, Antandra steals 40% of the enemy's Attack Rating and keeps it for 6 seconds. This ability cannot be stacked against a single target more than once, and the amount of Attack Rating stolen cannot exceed 450% of her own Attack Rating value.

builderSkills.name: Mark of the Wild
builderSkills.desc: Antandra attacks an enemy for 220% damage, imprinting her mark upon them for 4 seconds. While marked, the enemy's Accuracy is reduced by 80 and their Energy recovery is reduced by 60%.

builderSkills.name: Piercing Assault
builderSkills.desc: Antandra throws her spear at the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, dealing 180% damage to all enemies it penetrates. Antandra then dashes over to the enemy target, after which she receives a shield which exists for 5 seconds, that has a value equal to 550% of the target Attack Rating, but will not exceed 1000% of her own Attack Rating. Enemies hit by Antandra's spear are marked by Antandra. Antandra cannot be controlled and ignores enemy dodges while this ability is active.

builderSkills.name: Knockdown
builderSkills.desc: Antandra uses her spear to swipe at nearby enemies, dealing 180% damage to them, also knocking them down, meanwhile Antandra recovers 22% of the health she has already lost. Antandra also recovers an additional 8% of her max health for every enemy that she knocks down.

sigItem.name: Unconquerable
sigItem.desc: Allies that strike marked enemies will have their Accuracy increased by 70 points and Crit Rating increased by 15 points for 4 seconds. This ability cannot be stacked.

builderSkills.name: Elemental Surge
builderSkills.desc: Eironn combines both of his blades to form one powerful blade and proceeds to hack at his enemies, dealing 270% damage to them. Eironn then summons an ice tornado which deals AoE damage to enemies and remains on the battlefield for 5 seconds, engulfing multiple enemies, knocking them backwards and slowing their movement speed.

builderSkills.name: Twin Force
builderSkills.desc: When attacking with his ice blade, Eironn deals 150% damage to all enemies standing in front of him and also freezes them, causing their movement and attack speeds to be slowed for 4 seconds. When attacking with his wind blade, Eironn attacks a single enemy target, knocking them backwards, inflicting 180% damage upon them. The wind blade also inflicts additional damage equal to 15% of the enemy target's current health.

builderSkills.name: Vortex
builderSkills.desc: Eironn uses his elemental powers to generate a powerful gust of wind that draws in all enemies standing within a certain range of himself which deals 140% damage to them.

builderSkills.name: Sylvan Oath
builderSkills.desc: Sylvan Oath is a passive ability that increases Eironn's Attack Rating by 15% and gives his attacks a 30% chance to ignore his enemies' Defense Ratings. Any damage dealt to enemies that are using shield abilities is multiplied by 150% times.

sigItem.name: Chill
sigItem.desc: The ability "Elemental Surge" has a chance to cause enemies to become frozen for 2 seconds. The chances of an enemy being frozen are raised if the enemy is already suffering from attack speed reductions, and enemies which are already frozen will no longer be knocked back by the ability.

builderSkills.name: Phantom Assassin
builderSkills.desc: Baden summons a shadow phantom that possesses 90% of his own health and Attack Rating. The phantom is able to use all of Baden's abilities except for his ultimate ability and will suffer 150% damage when attacked.

builderSkills.name: Phantom Strike
builderSkills.desc: Baden summons a phantom behind an enemy's back that lasts for 6 seconds that proceeds to attack them, dealing 180% damage to them. The phantom possesses 70% of Baden's Health and Attack Rating but will be dealt 220% damage when attacked and may only attack with Normal Attacks.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Onslaught
builderSkills.desc: Baden unleashes a three-stage attack on surrounding enemies, with each attack dealing 135% damage to enemy targets.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Surge
builderSkills.desc: Baden's Attack Rating is increased by 3% for every phantom on the battlefield, Baden is also able to mitigate 20% damage for every phantom on the battlefield.

sigItem.name: Phantom Force
sigItem.desc: Each time a total of 4 phantom Badens disappear from the battlefield, Baden will initiate the effects of his "Phantom Strike" ability.

builderSkills.name: Crippling Blow
builderSkills.desc: Hendrik smashes the ground with his shield, dealing 140% damage to surrounding enemies, leaving them stunned for 1 seconds. Every 10% of Hendrik's maximum health that is lost will extend the ability's stun effect by 0.2 seconds, which can be extended up to a total of 4 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Shield Bash
builderSkills.desc: Hendrik uses his shield to knock back an enemy which deals 130% damage to them and also stuns them for 1.5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Sacrificial Shield
builderSkills.desc: If one of Hendrik's backline teammates receives fatal damage, Hendrik will jump in front of them and take all of the damage intended for his teammate for 10 seconds. Hendrik cannot be mind-controlled while protecting teammates and this ability may only be used once per battle.

builderSkills.name: Standfast
builderSkills.desc: When Hendrik's health falls below 40% he places his shield to the ground and assumes a defensive stance while he heals himself for 6% of his max health per second. When in this defensive stance, any damage dealt to Hendrik is reduced by 30%. This ability lasts for 10 seconds or until 90% of Hendrik's max health is restored. This ability may only be used once per battle.

sigItem.name: Steadfast
sigItem.desc: At the beginning of battles Hendrik's max health is increased by 300% of his Attack Rating. The max health increase will not affect the proportion of health that Hendrik already possesses.

builderSkills.name: Falling Sun
builderSkills.desc: Safiya focuses her energy into a large, powerful orb that deals AoE damage on impact. Depending on how long Safiya focuses her energy, the orb can deal from 100% damage up to 540% damage, with the area of effect also increasing in radius. Pressing Safiya's portrait initiates the focusing stage of the ability, pressing the portrait once more releases the orb.

builderSkills.name: Scattered Bolt
builderSkills.desc: Safiya fires a magic projectile at an enemy target which deals 170% damage and stuns them for a short time. After impacting the first enemy target, the projectile splits into 2 small and weaker projectiles that target other nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Static Field
builderSkills.desc: Safiya provides the most forward positioned ally with an electric aura that lasts for 10 seconds. The electric aura causes 70% damage per second to every enemy standing within its radius.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Disruption
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of the battle Safiya casts a circular enchantment over backline allies that lasts for 25 seconds. All allies standing within the circle have their Attack Ratings increased by 16% and any enemies standing within the circle have their Attack Ratings reduced by 50% as well as their haste reduced.

sigItem.name: Arcane Power
sigItem.desc: 1% of Safiya's total damage output is converted into her Attack Rating. The Attack Rating can be increased up to a total of 140%.

builderSkills.name: Dazzle
builderSkills.desc: Rowan throws copious amounts of gold coins onto the battlefield which 3 random targets will receive every 0.5 seconds. If the coins are collected by any allies, they will recover 50 Energy points and their Attack Rating will be increased by 30% for 8 seconds. If the coins are received by any enemies, they will be stunned for 4 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Avian Assault
builderSkills.desc: Rowan's duck attacks the nearest enemy multiple times for 60% damage each, causing the enemy's accuracy to drop by 120 points for 10 seconds while also allowing Rowan to steal 80 of the enemy's Energy points.

builderSkills.name: Healthy Supplies
builderSkills.desc: After entering the battlefield, Rowan sets up a supply stall and places 3 health potions upon it. When a nearby ally's health drops below 50% a potion will be used to restore 30% of their max health. Each hero may use a potion once every 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Damage Control
builderSkills.desc: When Rowan receives damage that exceeds 10% of his max health, he will use his Energy to mitigate the damage, causing him to lose Energy instead of health. This ability can be used once every 3 seconds. Energy lost when using this ability is determined by the damage which is mitigated. A maximum of 80 Energy points can be used to mitigate damage.

sigItem.name: Thirsty Work
sigItem.desc: After entering the battle Rowan will set up a stall that now includes an Energy potion. When an ally's Energy is above 600 points they will drink a potion, replenishing 60 Energy points. The Energy potion will be replenished each time the stall is set up.

builderSkills.name: Firedance
builderSkills.desc: Satrana initiates a fire dance, during which time she becomes immune to all attacks and control abilities. Satrana's attack deals 80% damage multiple times to the enemy, with the final attack dealing 200% explosive damage to the target.

builderSkills.name: Flutter Flame
builderSkills.desc: Satrana's Normal Attacks change, allowing her to pounce forward a small distance and deal 120% damage 2 times to the enemy target. Damage received by Satrana is reduced by 25% while this attack's animation is in motion.

builderSkills.name: Fireseeds
builderSkills.desc: Satrana throws fireseeds onto an enemy (prioritizes enemies according to the order of their formation numbers). While the fireseeds are on the enemy, the enemy loses 1% of their max health per second. Once the enemy target's health falls below 25%, the fireseeds explode, causing 300% AoE damage.

builderSkills.name: Overflow
builderSkills.desc: When an attack or ability inflicts damage on an enemy, the enemy burns for 3 seconds. Enemies that are burning have the healing they receive reduced by 50 and lose a value of health equal to 35% of Satrana's Attack Rating every second. This ability cannot be stacked.

sigItem.name: Mark of the Fox
sigItem.desc: Enemies that possess a higher percentage of health compared to Satrana's own deal 20% less damage to Satrana.

builderSkills.name: Divine Fury
builderSkills.desc: Athalia attacks her enemies with lightning speed and precision, slashing them 3 times from various positions on the battlefield. Each slash deals 160% damage to all enemies in her path. The third slash has a 100% critical strike chance.

builderSkills.name: Judgement
builderSkills.desc: Athalia descends from the heavens onto the battlefield and targets the enemy directly opposite her, inflicting 280% damage on them. Once the initial attack has finished, Athalia will stand and attack the targeted enemy normally. Enemies will not be able to regenerate Energy when attacked by this ability.

builderSkills.name: Purging Frenzy
builderSkills.desc: Athalia unleashes a multi-staged attack on the enemy nearest to her, with the final blow dealing 150% damage to the target that also leaves them stunned for 2 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Protection
builderSkills.desc: Athalia uses a divine aura that allows herself to mitigate 8% of all received damage for every ally still alive on the battlefield.

sigItem.name: Bloodless
sigItem.desc: Defense Rating is increased by 4% of the value of Athalia's Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Fissure
builderSkills.desc: Ezizh causes an explosion that deals 180% damage to any surrounding enemies. The explosion causes part of the ground to burn, damaging any enemies standing upon it for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Feeble Mind
builderSkills.desc: Ezizh mind controls the enemy farthest away from himself, causing them to walk towards him, also rendering the enemy unable to attack. Once in front of Ezizh, the enemy is dealt 210% damage and knocked into the air.

builderSkills.name: Horrify
builderSkills.desc: Ezizh launches an ungodly shockwave towards all of his enemies that inflicts 160% damage upon them, rendering them unable to cast their ultimate abilities for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Mental Fury
builderSkills.desc: Ezizh enrages his teammates, allowing them to to regain 40 Energy points every 3 seconds.

sigItem.name: Immolate
sigItem.desc: Enemies with less than 30% health will be stunned for a short period of time when taking damage dealt by the Ultimate skill, Fissure.

builderSkills.name: Battle Cry
builderSkills.desc: Gorvo roars angrily, dealing 130% to all enemies. Gorvo's roar is able to taunt enemies within a certain radius into targeting him with Normal Attacks for 5 seconds. Gorvo is also able to deflect 60% of the damage he receives back at his enemies while this ability is active.

builderSkills.name: Dive Bomb
builderSkills.desc: Gorvo assails his enemies by leaping into the air and dive bombing into their midst, inflicting 160% AoE damage on any enemies close enough to him, the ability also leaves enemies stunned for 2 seconds. Gorvo cannot be targeted while using this ability.

builderSkills.name: Shell Shock
builderSkills.desc: Gorvo charges his war hammer up every 8 seconds, causing the following attack to become a critical strike that deals AoE damage to nearby enemies, leaving them stunned for 2 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Shell Shield
builderSkills.desc: After entering the battlefield Gorvo casts a shield around himself that is equal to 40% of his maximum health which lasts for 6 seconds. The shield is also activated every time Gorvo uses his ultimate ability.

builderSkills.name: Blades of Fury
builderSkills.desc: Kelthur targets the enemy that is farthest away from himself with his shuriken which deals 65% damage to all enemies standing in its path. Once the shuriken reaches its final target, Kelthur catches it and proceeds to attack the enemy target for 180% damage.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Riposte
builderSkills.desc: Kelthur completely dodges an incoming enemy attack and jumps in front of the attacker, unleashing a counter-attack on them that deals 150% damage. Ability is activated once every 10 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Displace
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battles Kelthur swaps places with an enemy target. Any damage that the enemy receives will be increased by 35% for 7 seconds. This ability prioritizes enemy targets that mirror Kelthur's position on the battlefield.

builderSkills.name: Ethereal Resurgence
builderSkills.desc: When Kelthur dies he comes back to the battlefield in spectral form. While in this spectral form Kelthur cannot be attacked, however he will gradually lose health over time. Simultaneously Kelthur is still able to use his Normal Attacks and ultimate ability normally in combat. Kelthur's Haste is increased by 80% for the time that he remains on the battlefield in spectral form.

sigItem.name: Blood Sap
sigItem.desc: When any non-summoned allies which are within 20 levels of Kelthur's own level are defeated, Kelthur's Attack Rating will be increased by 20%.

builderSkills.name: Mesmerize
builderSkills.desc: Mehira entrances an enemy heroes which causes them to start attacking each other with their Normal Attacks for 4 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Whiplash
builderSkills.desc: Mehira uses her whip to deal 120% AoE damage to everyone in front of her, including allies. If this ability inflicts damage upon any of her allies, they will recover 65 Energy and their Haste will be increased by 40% for 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Infatuation
builderSkills.desc: Deals 60% damage to a single enemy target and reduces the damage Mehira may receive from the enemy target by 40% for 10 seconds. Simultaneously, Mehira will leech 3% of the enemy's current health to restore her own.

builderSkills.name: Hellspawn
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battles Mehira will sacrifice 60% of her current health to summon 3 minions which will automatically attack her enemies for 65% damage. After returning from an attack the minions will convert 30% of the damage they have inflicted upon their enemies back to Mehira as health and if Mehira receives any fatal damage she will sacrifice a minion in order to restore 25% of her maximum health.

sigItem.name: Carnal Bliss
sigItem.desc: When any non-summoned allies lose health, 10% of the health lost will be restored to Mehira.

builderSkills.name: Divine Arrow
builderSkills.desc: Gwyneth fires a divine arrow into the sky which splits into multiple arrows that then rain down upon the enemy half of the battlefield, dealing 210% damage to any enemies that are struck while also reducing their Accuracy by 90 for 8 seconds. This ability cannot be activated if the enemy side of the battlefield is empty.

builderSkills.name: Flaming Arrows
builderSkills.desc: Gwyneth's Normal Attacks will prioritize the enemy directly opposite her current position. Her Normal Attacks deal high damage but have a low attack frequency. Gwyneth's Normal Attacks have a 60% chance to become flaming arrows. Gwyneth's flaming arrows deal 220% damage to enemies on impact and cause them to burn for 5 seconds, dealing 40% damage per second.

builderSkills.name: Lightning Arrows
builderSkills.desc: Normal Attacks have a 60% chance to become lightning arrows that can damage multiple nearby enemies for 220% damage with chain lightning. Lightning arrows can also be combined with flaming arrows, allowing for the burning effect of the "Flaming Arrow" skill to also affect multiple nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Strength In Numbers
builderSkills.desc: Accuracy is raised by 80 and Crit Rating is raised by 25% when there are no enemies in Gwyneth's immediate vicinity.

sigItem.name: Focus Fire
sigItem.desc: Attack Rating is raised to 10% when in close proximity to allied heroes.

builderSkills.name: Motivation
builderSkills.desc: Rosaline will continuously follow the ally with the highest Attack Rating from start to finish. While following her ally, the damage that Rosaline receives is reduced by 40%. Using this ability fully restores the Energy of the ally Rosaline is currently following to its maximum. Rosaline expends a greater amount of her own Energy when the amount of Energy restored to her ally is higher, with at least 200 Energy points being expended each time this ability is used.

builderSkills.name: Crazy Crockery
builderSkills.desc: Rosaline takes out 2 teacups or teapots and hurls them at an enemy, inflicting 120% damage per item upon the target, leaving them temporarily stunned. Rosaline will prioritize her attack against the enemies that are attacking the ally she is currently following.

builderSkills.name: Afternoon Tea
builderSkills.desc: Rosaline heals the ally she is following for 150% worth of her Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Spring Cleaning
builderSkills.desc: Rosaline cannot be attacked while she uses her broom to sweep the floor for 4 seconds, dealing 80% damage to the enemy that nears the ally she is currently following. If the ally that Rosaline is following is a backline hero, then her attacks will incorporate a knockback effect, which pushes the enemy away.

sigItem.name: Servitude
sigItem.desc: Rosaline raises the Attack and Defense Ratings of the ally she is currently following for 8% of her own ratings' values.

builderSkills.name: Hope
builderSkills.desc: Elijah and Lailah both fight independently but share the same health and Energy, they also possess an additional 35% health. After activating this skill, Elijah and Lailah dance with one another, motivating all allied heroes, increasing their haste by 75 for 8 seconds. This skill cannot be used when Elijah is under the effects of enemy control abilities.

builderSkills.name: Grace
builderSkills.desc: Elijah and Lailah both independently cast blessings. Elijah heals the most injured ally for 130% of his Attack Rating, and Lailah restores 40 Energy points to the ally with the highest remaining amount of health. If an allied hero has yet to receive a blessing from the other Celestial Twin, they shall be prioritized, but even greater priority shall be given to the two frontline heroes while they are alive.

builderSkills.name: Cleanse
builderSkills.desc: If Lailah is affected by an enemy control ability, Elijah will remove all negative effects from Lailah and create a shield around her equal to 280% of their Attack Rating. When an enemy nears Elijah, Lailah will teleport to his location, attacking the enemy for 180% damage, knocking them back in the process.

builderSkills.name: Unity
builderSkills.desc: The last two allies to be affected by Lailah and Elijah's "Grace" skill will form a union. In this state of union, the two heroes will both take 30% of the damage that is inflicted upon the other, subsequently lessening the damage of the allied hero which is attacked.

sigItem.name: Blessed Binding
sigItem.desc: When Lailah and Elijah are in close proximity to one another, their Attack Rating will be increased by 5%. When they are far apart from one another, their Defense Rating will be increased by 15%.

builderSkills.name: Injected Fury
builderSkills.desc: Silas jumps beside his weakest ally and injects them with a powerful substance which increases their Attack Rating by 50% and causes them to become immune to all damage for 8 seconds. Once this ability has ended, the affected ally will be dealt 70% of the total amount of damage that was negated while they were in an immune state, but will not die as a result of it.

builderSkills.name: Stimulated Rage
builderSkills.desc: Silas is able to immediately heal his weakest ally for 12% of their max health. Once healed, the ally is able to recover 35% of Silas' Attack Rating value as health per second over a duration of 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Double Dosage
builderSkills.desc: Silas sprays a powerful gas onto the battlefield that remains there for 12 seconds. Any allies standing within the gas cloud will recover health equal to 30% of Silas' Attack Rating value per second. If any enemies are standing within the gas cloud, they will suffer 60% damage per second.

builderSkills.name: Healing Haze
builderSkills.desc: Silas creates a gas cloud that is capable of moving slowly around the battlefield. Any allies within the cloud's radius will recover 20% of the health that they've already lost per second. The cloud will disappear once a total healing value equal to 500% of Silas' Attack Rating has been reached.

sigItem.name: Adrenaline Shot
sigItem.desc: Each time an enemy loses 1% of their max health, their Health Recovery Rate decreases by 0.6%, which may be further decreased up until it reaches a total value of 36%. Each time an ally loses 1% of their max health, their Health Recovery Rate increases by 0.8%, which may be increased up until it reaches a total value of 48%.

builderSkills.name: Time Rift
builderSkills.desc: Zolrath expends 200 Energy to open a time rift. Once inside the time rift, Zolrath will continuously lose 120 Energy points per second while he recovers 7.5% of his max health. When Zolrath's Energy is exhausted, his health is fully recovered or the ability is used again, Zolrath will reappear from the time rift and attack the weakest enemy target for 360% damage. This ability may be used even if Zolrath is being controlled by an enemy ability.

builderSkills.name: Doppelganger
builderSkills.desc: Zolrath and his future self deal 50% damage multiple times to an enemy. The final 2 attacks on the enemy deal 180% damage each to any enemy in the attack's path. While using this ability the two Zolrath's cannot be controlled, however both can receive damage.

builderSkills.name: Annihilate
builderSkills.desc: After 18 seconds Zolrath's Normal Attack becomes more powerful, allowing his Normal Attack to deal 150% damage twice per attack.

builderSkills.name: Déjà vu
builderSkills.desc: When Zolrath is on the brink of death and all of his allies are already dead, Zolrath will turn back time, causing the battle to be reverted back to its start. Zolrath will maintain the effects of his "Annihilate" ability even after the battle has been reverted. This ability may only be used once per battle and can only be used in certain game modes.

sigItem.name: Prey
sigItem.desc: Damage dealt to enemies with a lower health percentage than Zolrath is increased by 10%.

builderSkills.name: Tempest
builderSkills.desc: Lorsan summons a tempest amongst a concentrated area of enemies that continuously grows larger over time, dealing AoE damage multiple times to its surrounding enemies. Once reaching its maximum size, the tempest will explode, dealing 200% damage to nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Inner Sight
builderSkills.desc: Lorsan attacks an enemy for 170% damage and marks them with his inner sight symbol, which persists until the end of the battle. The symbol allows for the ultimate ability damage of all allied heroes to be raised by 250% against marked enemies for 4 seconds when an ultimate ability is used. This ability prioritizes unmarked heroes first.

builderSkills.name: Gale Force
builderSkills.desc: Lorsan links the farthest and closest enemies together. When one of the two enemies receives any damage, the other will receive 80% of the damage received.

builderSkills.name: Wind Ward
builderSkills.desc: Casts a shield upon 2 random allies which lasts for 7 seconds and is able to reduce damage equal to 250% of Lorsan's own Attack Rating.

sigItem.name: Fate
sigItem.desc: When an enemy linked by the "Gale Force" ability dies, Lorsan will receive a permanent 20 Haste increase until the end of the battle.

builderSkills.name: Judgement Day
builderSkills.desc: Cecilia summons a divine blade down upon the head of the enemy which currently has the most "Symbols of Sin" above their head, dealing 300% damage to them and further increasing number of symbols above their head by 1. When this ability is used against enemies marked with 3 or more symbols, the enemies will also be stunned for a period of time. If used against enemies marked with 5 symbols, the targeted enemy will be dealt triple the normal damage.

builderSkills.name: Blade of Purification
builderSkills.desc: Cecilia initiates a three-stage attack against an enemy, with each attack dealing 70% damage to the target. Each time this ability is used increases the enemy's "Symbols of Sins" by 1 symbol. The damage caused by this ability is increased by 10% for every additional symbol that the enemy is marked with. Enemies may be marked by a maximum of 5 symbols.

builderSkills.name: Atonement
builderSkills.desc: Cecilia does not appear immediately at the beginning of battles, but instead appears behind the enemy that mirrors her formation position, unleashing a three-stage attack on them, dealing 80% damage per attack to them while also marking them with 2 "Symbols of Sin".

builderSkills.name: Devil Trap
builderSkills.desc: Cecilia creates a divine circle that encompasses her enemies. All enemies within the divine circle have their Attack Ratings reduced by 60%. The first time each enemy tries to exit the circle will cause them to suffer 320% damage.

sigItem.name: Repentance
sigItem.desc: All allied heroes including Cecilia recover 200 Energy points and a total equivalent of 200% worth of Cecilia's Attack Rating as health over 5 seconds whenever the ability "Judgement Day" kills an enemy in less than 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Soul Burn
builderSkills.desc: Oden completely drains all Energy from the enemy that possesses the highest amount of Energy, dealing 160% base damage to them. An additional 1% damage is dealt to the enemy for every 1% of Energy that the enemy target has when the ability is cast against them. The higher the amount of Energy that Oden drains from his enemies will result in Oden losing a higher proportion of his own Energy. Oden will lose at least 300 Energy points when using this ability, regardless of his enemies' Energy levels.

builderSkills.name: Void Lightning
builderSkills.desc: Oden opens up a portal to the void, causing void lightning to blast out of it, striking the nearest enemy that is standing directly opposite him for 180% AoE damage.

builderSkills.name: Eviction
builderSkills.desc: Oden opens up a portal to the void that sucks in the enemy with the highest percentage of health. The targeted enemy is then thrown out of the portal and onto the weakest enemy target, resulting in 180% AoE damage being dealt to the affected targets.

builderSkills.name: Eye of Evil
builderSkills.desc: Oden accumulates one Fiend Point for every point of Energy he gains. When Oden reaches 300/1000/2000 Fiend Points respectively, one of his eyes will open until all three eyes are open.After Oden's first eye has been opened, the AoE damage effect caused by the skill "Eviction" will now include a stun effect, which stuns the affected enemies for 3 seconds.After Oden's second eye has been opened, the skill "Void Lightning" will additionally target the enemy that is currently standing farthest away from Oden.After Oden's third eye has been opened, Oden's normal attacks will cause his enemies to lose an additional 60 energy points per attack.

sigItem.name: Vengeful Fury
sigItem.desc: During battles, Oden gains 1 Fiend Point required for his "Eye of Evil" ability from every Energy Point taken away from his enemies.

builderSkills.name: Barrel Bomb
builderSkills.desc: Rigby hurls his barrel towards an enemy target which deals 150% damage on impact. Rigby then throws his pipe into the leaked contents of the barrel, causing it to explode and deal 260% AoE damage to nearby enemies. Enemies close to the explosion are set alight for 12 seconds and suffer 60% damage per second.

builderSkills.name: Fire Breath
builderSkills.desc: Rigby takes a large swig of his drink and spits it back out at nearby enemies, dealing 180% damage to them, also causing their Accuracy to be reduced by 80 points for 6 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Drunken Frenzy
builderSkills.desc: Rigby drinks himself into a drunken frenzy which reduces all the damage he receives by 14% and also increases his Haste by 25 points. The effects of "Drunken Frenzy" can be stacked up to 3 times, with the third time causing Rigby to become even more enraged, further increasing his Haste by 120 points for 8 seconds, after which he returns to his normal state.

builderSkills.name: Well Rested
builderSkills.desc: After the effects of "Drunken Frenzy" have worn off, Rigby will recover 5% of his max health per second for 12 seconds.

sigItem.name: Fiery Demise
sigItem.desc: Rigby's "Fire Breath" skill will trigger an additional explosion on enemies currently set alight by the skill "Barrel Bomb", resulting in 200% damage being dealt to them.

builderSkills.name: Time Suspension
builderSkills.desc: Orthros stops time for 3 seconds, causing everyone and everything but himself to become frozen. Orthros then attacks the weakest enemy on the battlefield at lightning speed, inflicting 60% damage per attack on the enemy.

builderSkills.name: Time Trap
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of the battle, Orthros will set up a time trap that individually targets the 2 enemies that are currently closest to him. The time traps will then explode within the first 20 seconds of battle. Once a time trap is triggered it will cause 320% AoE damage to nearby enemies, the time trap will also be triggered if an affected enemy dies.

builderSkills.name: Inertia
builderSkills.desc: Deals 200% damage to a single enemy target and prevents them from recovering Energy for the following 9 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Celestial Vigor
builderSkills.desc: Orthros' max health is increased by 2.5% per second, up until it reaches 150%. The ratio of Orthros' current health will not be affected by the new increased max health value. Zolrath's "Déjà vu" skill will not affect this skill's cumulative time.

sigItem.name: Time Warp
sigItem.desc: Reduces the Haste of enemies that get too close to Orthros by 30 points.

builderSkills.name: Twisted Fate
builderSkills.desc: Tidus spirals into a whirlwind that engulfs the battlefield, dealing 160% damage to all enemies that he passes, finally pouncing on the weakest enemy target for 180% damage.

builderSkills.name: Frenzied Strikes
builderSkills.desc: Tidus slices the enemy standing in front of him in a vicious five-stage attack, dealing 60% damage per attack to the target. Due to profuse blood loss, the enemy target suffers 65% damage per second over 8 seconds whenever they move.

builderSkills.name: Battle Howl
builderSkills.desc: Tidus lets out a ferocious howl that terrifies his enemies, causing them to flee from his vicinity for 5 seconds. After howling, Tidus' movement speed is increased by 35% and his Attack Rating is increased by 20% for 10 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Savagery
builderSkills.desc: Tidus viciously and persistently attacks an enemy whose health is lower than 50% of its maximum until they are slain. While using this ability, the Attack Rating of Tidus' Normal Attack is increased by 35%.

sigItem.name: Battle Hardened
sigItem.desc: Reduces all damage that Tidus receives by 40% for the first 6 seconds after "Savagery" is used.

builderSkills.name: Toxic Transfusion
builderSkills.desc: Izold utilizes a powerful chemical agent that immediately restores 50% of the health he has already lost while also increasing his Haste by 20 points and Attack Rating by 35% for 12 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Noxious Blast
builderSkills.desc: When Izold's health is greater than 30% he will use his Noxious Gas ability, dealing damage equal to 3% of his own health as damage to nearby enemies. Noxious Gas also causes Izold to receive damage equal to 1% of his own health as damage.

builderSkills.name: Needle Strike
builderSkills.desc: Izold charges into a single enemy target, stunning them and knocking them backwards, finally stabbing the enemy with his needle for 190% damage.

builderSkills.name: Hypodermic Healing
builderSkills.desc: Izold injects himself, restoring 16% of the health the he's already lost per second over 8 seconds.

sigItem.name: Lethal Dose
sigItem.desc: When Izold uses "Toxic Transfusion" he will also receive the effects of his "Hypodermic Healing" ability.

builderSkills.name: Aura of Haste
builderSkills.desc: Oscar throws 4 knives into the ground, forming a magical aura on the ground that deals 270% AoE damage to nearby enemies. The aura exists for 11 seconds and increases Oscar's Haste by 100 points while he is standing inside it.

builderSkills.name: Fine Cuts
builderSkills.desc: Oscar targets the 2 weakest enemies and throws knives at them, dealing 180% to them. This attack causes Oscar's knives to remain stuck in the ground to be potentially used again.

builderSkills.name: Slice and Dice
builderSkills.desc: Oscar instantaneously appears next to a knife stuck in the ground, picks it up, and proceeds to slice up any nearby enemies for 200% damage.

builderSkills.name: Unfazed
builderSkills.desc: Oscar scrubs his glasses clean, removing the majority of de-buff effects which are currently affecting him and simultaneously increases his Crit Rating by 25 points and his Dodge Rating by 95 points which will remain that way until Oscar falls victim to any enemy control abilities.

sigItem.name: Uninvited Guest
sigItem.desc: If an enemy appears on the allied side of the battlefield, Oscar instantaneously appears beside them and proceeds to kick them back into their own half of the battlefield, resulting in 200% damage being dealt to the enemy.

builderSkills.name: Fire Born
builderSkills.desc: Talene goes into 'Phoenix' form that lasts until death and converts 90% of her current health into a permanent shield of equal value, plus an additional extra permanent shield on top that is equal to 20% of her max health. Talene's Normal Attacks will turn into close-range area attacks that deal 150% damage while in Phoenix form.

builderSkills.name: Meteor Shower
builderSkills.desc: Talene calls down a fiery meteorite that deals 200% damage to a single enemy target. When Talene is in Phoenix form, meteorites will continually fall randomly every 0.5 seconds upon random enemy targets for a certain duration of time.

builderSkills.name: Phoenix Rising
builderSkills.desc: Every time Talene dies she transforms into a fireball. While in this state, Talene recovers 7% of her max health every second and cannot be targeted by her enemies but will still receive the positive effects of her allies' abilities. Once Talene's health reaches 50%, she is reborn, resulting in a brilliant explosion that deals 200% area damage to enemies. Talene's Recovery Rate is reduced by 20% every subsequent time that she transforms into a fireball.

builderSkills.name: Afterglow
builderSkills.desc: A passive ability that allows for Talene's 2 weakest allies to respectively recover 150% of Talene's Attack Rating as health each time Talene cumulatively loses 10% of her max health.

sigItem.name: Resurgence
sigItem.desc: Talene's Attack Rating is increased by 10% and her Defense Rating is increased by 20% every time she is reborn using her "Phoenix Rising" ability.

builderSkills.name: Phase Form
builderSkills.desc: Enabling phase form creates a phased, ephemeral version of Saurus that copies several of Saurus' abilities for 9 seconds, which deals 85% of the original Saurus' damage value.

builderSkills.name: War Strike
builderSkills.desc: Saurus uses his spear to attack all nearby enemy targets for 170% AoE damage, after which he proceeds to attack the nearest enemy target, dealing a further 280% damage to them, also causing them to become stunned for 2 seconds. Successfully using this ability without any interruptions resets the cooldown timer of Saurus' "Burst Strikes" ability.

builderSkills.name: Burst Strikes
builderSkills.desc: Saurus deals 100% AoE damage 4 times to all enemies within his attack range. Successfully using this ability without any interruptions resets the cooldown timer of Saurus' "War Strike" ability.

builderSkills.name: Relentless
builderSkills.desc: When Saurus or his phase form use either of their "War Strike" or "Burst Strikes" abilities without any interruptions, Saurus' Attack Rating will be increased by 10% and his Defense Rating will be increased by 25%. This ability can be stacked 5 times. If any of Saurus' abilities are interrupted, this effect will end.

builderSkills.name: Running Chest Jab
builderSkills.desc: Nakoruru knocks a single enemy target onto the ground, removing all of their defensive shield effects as a result and then proceeds to stab the enemy, dealing 460% damage the target.

builderSkills.name: Kamui Rimuse
builderSkills.desc: Nakoruru attacks any enemies that are within range of her 3 times. Each attack deals 190% damage to the targets and also interrupts their current actions.

builderSkills.name: Shichikapu Etu
builderSkills.desc: Mamahaha swoops down and attacks a backline enemy as they are preparing to use an ability (excludes ultimate abilities), dealing 220% damage to them, causing them to be stunned for 2 seconds. This ability can be activated once every 6 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Kamui Matsube
builderSkills.desc: Nakoruru is carried by Mamahaha towards the weakest enemy target. Once close enough, Nakoruru pounces on the enemy target, dealing 280% damage to them. This ability may be used up to 2 times per battle; once when Nakoruru's health falls below 70% for the first time and again when it falls below 40% for the first time. While being carried by Mamahaha, Nakoruru cannot be attacked and will recover 400% worth of her Attack Rating as health.

sigItem.name: Heavy Slash
sigItem.desc: Stuns enemies for 1.5 seconds and sends them hurtling into the air whenever a Normal Attack deals a Critical Damage.

builderSkills.name: Frozen Mist
builderSkills.desc: Khazard explodes, dealing an initial 130% damage to all enemies on the battlefield, causing the battlefield to become enveloped in a "Frozen Mist" for 14 seconds. While the frozen mist is present, enemies will suffer 45% damage per second and enemies with health lower than 30% will become frozen until the are able to recover 30% of their health or the mist disappears.

builderSkills.name: Glacial Shards
builderSkills.desc: Khazard fires 3 "Glacial Shards" in multiple directions. Each glacial shard deals 150% damage to the enemies which are struck, also causing them to lose 50 Haste points for 4 seconds. Any enemies that are struck by multiple ice shards will be dealt 50% less damage by subsequent shards after the second glacial shard.

builderSkills.name: Frozen Beam
builderSkills.desc: Khazard fires an icy beam at an enemy which deals 220% damage to them and causes them to become frozen for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Frost Serpent
builderSkills.desc: While there is "Frozen Mist" present on the battlefield, Khazard's "Frost Serpent" attacks an enemy with its ice breath, dealing 160% damage to them, causing them to become frozen for 2 seconds.

sigItem.name: Frozen Curse
sigItem.desc: Passive. Reduces all enemies' Dissolve by 30 points.

builderSkills.name: Deadly Ambush
builderSkills.desc: Drez instantly moves to the weakest enemy. For the following 15 seconds, Drez will prioritize the pursuit of that enemy, during which time Normal Melee Attacks become stronger and Drez's Crit Rating is increased by 100%.

builderSkills.name: Bloody Eviseration
builderSkills.desc: Drez spins in a full circle, dealing 210% damage to nearby enemies, reducing their Defense Rating by 70% for 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Tactical Retreat
builderSkills.desc: When Drez's health falls below 50% for the first time, he leaves the battlefield for 5 seconds, during which time he recovers 100 Energy points per second. While away from the battlefield, using Drez's Ultimate ability will cause him to prematurely return to the battlefield. If Drez's Ultimate ability "Deadly Ambush" is already being used when he disappears from the battlefield, he will continue to use it once he returns.

builderSkills.name: The Rabid Slice
builderSkills.desc: Drez's Crit Damage Amplification is increased by 40 points and his Attack Speed is increased by 15 points. During the use of his ultimate ability "Deadly Ambush", Drez receives an additional 25 Attack Speed points.

builderSkills.name: Smite
builderSkills.desc: Arthur will claim Excalibur from a lake the first time this ability is used. Once he is wielding the Lake Excalibur, Arthur's Normal Attacks will be greatly strengthened. Any subsequent uses of this ability will then deal 380% AoE damage to enemies in front of Arthur.

builderSkills.name: Shield of Honor
builderSkills.desc: Attacks that strike Arthur face on deal 50% less damage to him.

sigItem.name: Battle Rally
sigItem.desc: Arthur rallies his team, raising the attack frequency of Normal Attacks for all allies standing behind Arthur by 50%.

builderSkills.name: Blossom Fall
builderSkills.desc: Solise deals 280% damage to all enemies on the battlefield, leaving them temporarily stunned. Using this ability causes cherry blossom leaves to fall upon the battlefield for 20 seconds. While cherry blossom leaves are falling, all of Solise's other abilities will gain a power increase.

builderSkills.name: Floral Disruption
builderSkills.desc: Solise throws a vial at a single enemy target, dealing 200% damage to them, causing them to become temporarily stunned. When "Blossom Fall" is occurring, enemies in close proximity to the original target will also from suffer this ability's effects.

builderSkills.name: Floral Specter
builderSkills.desc: Solise summons a Floral Specter that possesses 50% of Solise's health which remains on the battlefield for 15 seconds. When "Blossom Fall" is occurring, the Floral Specter will deal 90% worth of Solise's Attack Rating as damage to nearby enemies.

sigItem.name: Flower Power
sigItem.desc: The Floral Specter will attack 2 enemies simultaneously.

builderSkills.name: Desert Vortex
builderSkills.desc: Skriath summons a sand vortex that appears in the center of the enemy formation which persists for 5 seconds. The vortex has an AoE radius which continuously pulls in enemies, dealing 70% damage per second to all enemies that are trapped in its grasp.

builderSkills.name: Death from Above
builderSkills.desc: Skriath causes large rocks to fall upon an enemy targets's head, dealing 160% AoE damage to them and any nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Sandstorm
builderSkills.desc: Skriath creates "Sandstorm" which lasts for 12 seconds. The sandstorm reduces the Accuracy of all enemies by 100 points and Haste by 25 while they are standing within the sandstorm.

builderSkills.name: Critical Insight
builderSkills.desc: Increases allies' Crit Ratings by 0.5 points per second until a maximum of 20 points are reached.

sigItem.name: Boulder Blast
sigItem.desc: Each time Skriath deals a Critical Strike to an enemy target, large rocks fall down on them, dealing 50% AoE damage to them and any nearby enemies. This ability is unable to deal critical damage itself and can only target the same enemy once every 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Cloud Clones
builderSkills.desc: Wu Kong disappears from the battlefield after summoning 3 clones of himself. Once all the clones have disappeared from the battlefield, the original Wu Kong will return to it. Cloud clones are able to use Wu Kong's "Bludgeon" ability as well as his Normal Attacks. Clones possess 90% of the original Wu Kong's stats, however, they will receive 220% damage dealt from enemy attacks.

builderSkills.name: Bludgeon
builderSkills.desc: Wu Kong uses his rod to bludgeon his enemies, dealing 180% area damage to them. This ability also deals additional damage that is equal to 8% of his enemies' current health value. When there are no enemies nearby, Wu Kong will travel towards his enemies upon his cloud and proceed to attack them when within range.

builderSkills.name: Falling Fury
builderSkills.desc: Wu Kong throws his rod into the air so that it falls down upon the most densely concentrated area of enemies on the battlefield, dealing 270% area damage to them. Enemies that were successfully struck by the rodwill lose 100 Haste points for 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Foresight
builderSkills.desc: Wu Kong is able to predict when his enemies will use control effects against him and will momentarily disappear from the battlefield to evade the attack and summon a cloud clone in his original position. The summoned clone shares the same attributes as Wu Kong's "Cloud Clones" and can be summoned once every 11 seconds.

sigItem.name: Golden Barrier
sigItem.desc: Wu Kong gains a 2-layer protective barrier at the start of battles. If Wu Kong is dealt damage that exceeds 10% of his max health he will lose 1 layer of his protective barriers without suffering any damage at all.

builderSkills.name: Devour
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Whenever Mezoth's health is higher than 50%, he is immune to control effects and receives 50 Dissolve points.When actively using his Ultimate ability, Mezoth imprisons an enemy up until his Energy is completely exhausted. During the imprisonment period, Mezoth loses 70 Energy per second while the imprisoned enemy loses health equal to 70% of Mezoth's Attack Rating every second and cannot attack or use any skills (enemies cannot die as a result of this damage). While under a control effect, Mezoth loses an additional 70 Energy per 0.5 seconds. If the enemy target is immune to control abilities, they will not be imprisoned and will be dealt damage of 480% Attack Rating instead. Allied heroes will prioritize their attacks on non-imprisoned enemies.

builderSkills.name: Abyssal Butchery
builderSkills.desc: Mezoth attempts to knock down an enemy. If Mezoth successfully knocks down an enemy, he proceeds to strike them multiple times, dealing 70% damage per strike, with the final strike dealing 220% damage to the enemy. Every time Mezoth lands a strike on the enemy, he will recover a proportion of health equal to 8% of the health already lost by the enemy.

builderSkills.name: Demonic Hunger
builderSkills.desc: Mezoth gains a shield for 7 seconds that is able to mitigate a damage value equal to 10% of his own max health. Mezoth hacks at enemies that are standing within a certain distance in front of himself, dealing damage equal to 20% of his own current health to them, also causing their Haste to be reduced by 50 points for 7 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Carnivorous Lust
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battles Mezoth's max health value is increased by 80%, and the percentage of health that he begins the battle with remains unchanged. The increased value of Mezoth's health will slowly diminish over 50 seconds, starting from the beginning of battles. The diminishing max health value does not affect the current percentage of Mezoth's overall health.

sigItem.name: Virclent Greed
sigItem.desc: Hero gains 200 Energy points at the start of battles.

builderSkills.name: Hientorajin
builderSkills.desc: Ukyo leaps at his enemies and unleashes 10 swift attacks against them, dealing 70% AoE damage per attack, with the final attack striking his enemies into the air. Ukyo is immune to all damage while using this ability.

builderSkills.name: Snowfall Slash
builderSkills.desc: Ukyo swiftly brings his sword out and attacks the enemies standing before him 7 times, dealing 70% AoE damage per attack to them, also interrupting their attacks. Ukyo is immune to all frontal attacks while using this ability.

builderSkills.name: Phantom Strike
builderSkills.desc: When there are no enemies in close proximity to Ukyo, he will rapidly move near to an enemy and unleash a triple-strike attack against them that deals 180% damage per attack. Each attack will knock back the enemy and cause them to become stunned for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Swallow Swipe
builderSkills.desc: Ukyo leaps into the air to attack his enemies, dealing 250% AoE damage to nearby enemies.

sigItem.name: Rage Eruption
sigItem.desc: This ability can be used once per battle. After using his ultimate ability, Ukyo will be immune to all control abilities for 8 seconds, his Attack Rating will be increased by 20% and his Life Leech attribute will be increased by 10 points.

builderSkills.name: Savage Stampede
builderSkills.desc: Anoki blows his war horn, calling forth a stampede of Iron-jaw beasts that are able to strike 3 enemies. Enemies standing in the Iron-jaws' way are dealt 50% damage and are carried backwards towards the edge of the screen. Once the enemies reach the edge of the screen they are sent hurtling into the air and suffer 120% damage which leaves them stunned for 2 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Raging Stomp
builderSkills.desc: Anoki stomps the ground 3 times, with the first two stomps each dealing 65% damage to the enemy, with the final stomp dealing 120% damage to them, that also leaves them stunned for 1.5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Born to Lead
builderSkills.desc: Anoki manifests an aura around himself that lasts for 8 seconds. While the aura is present, all allies including Anoki have their Attack Ratings increased by 8%, the damage they receive is reduced by 10% and the frequency of their Normal Attacks is increased by 15%. Melee heroes receive an extra increase of 150% for all of the preceding attributes.

builderSkills.name: Horn of War
builderSkills.desc: Used once at the start of battles, this ability grants allies a protective shield that lasts for 5 seconds, which is able to mitigate damage that is equal to 20% of Anoki's max health.

sigItem.name: War Fury
sigItem.desc: This skill raises Anoki's Attack Rating by 4% for every non-summoned ally that is standing near him and raises his Defense Rating by 10% for every enemy standing near him.

builderSkills.name: Piercing Bones
builderSkills.desc: Deals 300% damage to all enemies and causes bone spikes to protrude from the battlefield for 8 seconds. Bone spikes are able to deal damage once every 0.25 seconds. If an enemy moves positions within these 0.25 seconds, they will subsequently lose 3% of their max health. Torne regrows his bone whip after using this ability.

builderSkills.name: Bone Prison
builderSkills.desc: Torne traps an enemy within a prison of bones and then proceeds to smash into the enemy target, dealing 260% damage to them, also causing them to be knocked backwards. After being knocked backwards, the enemy loses 100 Haste points for a duration of 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Seething Death
builderSkills.desc: Torne deals 180% AoE damage 3 times to enemies that are standing before him, with the final attack leeching 25% health from the final enemy. All enemies that were struck by this attack are unable to recover life for the following 9 seconds. Torne regrows his bone whip after using this ability.

builderSkills.name: Absorption
builderSkills.desc: Torne absorbs the remains of any dead heroes on the battlefield and forms a bone whip out of their bones. Simultaneously, Torne recovers 30% of his max health and increases the value of his max health by the same amount. The area for all of Torne's AoE abilities is increased after this ability is used for the first time.

sigItem.name: Baneful Focus
sigItem.desc: Every time Torne forms a bone whip, his Attack Rating is increased by 10% and his Defense Rating is increased by 20% up until the battle ends. This ability can be stacked 6 times.

builderSkills.name: Sea of Flowers
builderSkills.desc: Flora targets the most densely packed group of enemies and unleashes a sea of flowers which lasts for 12 seconds onto them, dealing 200% AoE damage to the targets. Enemies that are within the sea of flowers lose 40% worth of Flora's Attack Rating as health per second. Only 1 sea of flowers may be active at a time.

builderSkills.name: Airborne
builderSkills.desc: Flora flies high into the air at the beginning of battles where she remains until all of her allies have perished, during which time she cannot be targeted by any enemies or allies. While in the air, Flora constantly releases magic dust down onto her enemies, dealing 110% AoE damage to the targets.

builderSkills.name: Swoop
builderSkills.desc: Flora sacrifices 25% of her current health in order to send her little bird swooping across the battlefield. Each enemy that is in the little bird's path is dealt an amount of damage equal to 55% of the health that Flora sacrificed. This ability cannot be used when Flora's health falls below 60%.

builderSkills.name: Rejuvenation
builderSkills.desc: Flora is able to recover 0.6% of her max health per second in battles while using this ability. Simultaneously, each time any non-summoned character (including enemies) recovers 10% of their max health, Flora will also recover 3.5% of that character's max health for herself.

sigItem.name: Diminish
sigItem.desc: Reduces an enemy's Haste by 20 points for 4 seconds when the ability "Swoop" deals Critical Damage to an enemy.

builderSkills.name: Soul Feast
builderSkills.desc: Daimon deals 260% damage to all enemy targets. If already unlocked, the ability "Blood Shield" will be used against the 2 enemies with the highest maximum health values. While Daimon is using his shield, he will suffer 35% of the damage received by his allies, but will not die as a result.

builderSkills.name: Blood Shield
builderSkills.desc: Daimon steals 18% health from the enemy with the highest maximum health and converts it into a shield that lasts for 5 seconds (health stolen does not kill the enemy). Once the shield has expired, its remaining shield value will be returned to the enemy as health.

builderSkills.name: Inanimate Companion
builderSkills.desc: Daimon uses his doll, Stitchy to attack the enemy standing in front of him 3 times, each attack deals 200% damage to the enemy, with the final attack causing the enemy to become stunned for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Forbidden Power
builderSkills.desc: Daimon deals 250% damage to a nearby enemy target, but also receives 120% damage himself. Effects of this ability cannot kill Daimon.

sigItem.name: Soul Sunder
sigItem.desc: After using the ability "Blood Shield", while the shield is still in use, Daimon temporarily gains 20% of the enemy target's Attack Rating and 30% of their Defense Rating. This ability cannot be stacked.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Divergence
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn splits herself into multiple Specters and flies in all directions, during which time she cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' abilities. Each Specter that passes through an enemy inflicts 150% damage upon them. Afterwards, the Specters converge on the weakest enemy target currently on the battlefield after which Theowyn re-manifests herself next to the target. Damage dealt to enemies during the ability's convergence phase is equal to the ability's initial attack damage.

builderSkills.name: Haunting Specter
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn enters spectral form to enshroud an enemy target and, prevent them from recovering any health. While the enemy is enshrouded, Theowyn deals 130% damage per second for a total duration of up to 8 seconds. Once Theowyn has finished enshrouding the enemy, she deals an additional 130% damage to the target. During the enshroud phase, Theowyn cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' abilities.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Curse
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn enters spectral form and charges ahead, cursing every enemy that she passes through, dealing 130% damage to them. If an enemy is already cursed, the curse is removed and Theowyn instead deals damage equal to 15% of the enemy's max health, ignoring all of their defense. Damage dealt cannot exceed 600% of Theowyn's Attack Rating. While in spectral form Theowyn is immune to enemy control abilities.

builderSkills.name: Song of Mourning
builderSkills.desc: Whenever Theowyn receives damage that exceeds 10% of her current health, the exceeding amount of damage shall be reduced by 55%.

sigItem.name: Sorrowful Affliction
sigItem.desc: This ability is activated every 15 seconds of battle. The 1 enemies which have dealt the highest amount of damage to Theowyn within the last 15 seconds shall be afflicted by the effects of Theowyn's "Spectral Curse" ability.

builderSkills.name: Eagle Vision
builderSkills.desc: Ezio marks all enemy targets with 'Execution Threshold' markers. If a target's health falls below the designated 'Execution Threshold' of 27% of their max health, Ezio will swiftly execute them. Each time this ability is used against enemies that are already marked by an 'Execution Threshold', their thresholds will be raised by a further 8% of their max health. When used against other heroes, the maximum execution threshold value will not exceed 1600% of Ezio's Attack Rating. When used against NPC bosses, the damage dealt is equal to 500% of Ezio's Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Final Retribution
builderSkills.desc: Activated once every 9 seconds, this ability allows Ezio to avoid all the damage he receives from a single enemy target's attack. After avoiding the enemy's attack, Ezio prioritizes a counter-attack against the attacking enemy. When counter attacking a nearby enemy, Ezio initiates a 6-stage attack on them, with each strike dealing 95% damage to the enemy. When counter attacking distant enemies, Ezio uses his crossbow to inflict 300% damage on the enemy target.

builderSkills.name: Smoke Bomb
builderSkills.desc: Nearby enemies lose 105 Accuracy points, their Crit Block Rate is reduced by 35% and they lose 70 Haste points for 9 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Evasion
builderSkills.desc: Ezio receives 4 Dodge points every 1 second during battles until 120 points are reached.

builderSkills.name: Ungodly Defiance
builderSkills.desc: The first time Lucretia uses her Ultimate ability, she absorbs her two revolving skulls, absorbing their Energy until the end of the battle. After absorbing the skulls, Lucretia's Life Leech is increased by 40 and her Energy Recovery rate is increased by 50%. Afterwards, each time she uses her Ultimate ability deals 280% AoE damage to nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Hellfire
builderSkills.desc: Flames encircle Lucretia for 10 seconds, dealing 60% damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies in close proximity to her. Enemies affected by Lucretia's flames have their Defense Ratings decreased by 15% for 2 seconds. This ability can be stacked.

builderSkills.name: Deathwish
builderSkills.desc: Lucretia marks the enemy with the highest Attack Rating and hunts them until their death. While Lucretia is hunting down the enemy target, the target's damage is reduced by 30%. If the enemy formation includes Zaphrael, Lucretia shall prioritize her attacks against Zaphrael above all other enemies.

builderSkills.name: Twin Terrors
builderSkills.desc: When positioned on the frontline, the Skull of Treachery is activated, raising Lucretia's Dodge by 50 points and her Tenacity by 20 points. When positioned on the backline, the Skull of Destruction is activated, raising Lucretia's Attack Speed by 15 points and her Crit Damage Amplification by 30 points. The effects of both skulls are simultaneously activated after Lucretia uses her Ultimate ability for the first time.

sigItem.name: Animus
sigItem.desc: Lucretia gains 150 Energy per second over 5 seconds when a non-summoned ally dies for the first time.

builderSkills.name: Transmogrification
builderSkills.desc: Pippa deals 270% damage to the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, simultaneously transforming them into an 'Acorn' which is incapable of attacking for 5 seconds. Pippa has a 25% chance of failing to correctly cast this spell. If Pippa fails, the spell's effects shall be cast upon herself.

builderSkills.name: Astral Shift
builderSkills.desc: Pippa teleports the closest enemy target onto the head of the next closest enemy, dealing 290% AoE damage and causing any enemies within range to become stunned for 3 seconds. Pippa has a 90% chance of cast failure on the first cast. If Pippa fails, her closest frontline ally is teleported on to the top of the farthest enemy target's head, but her ally shall not be injured or stunned.

sigItem.name: Pippa Power
sigItem.desc: Every time Pippa fires a magic orb, she has a 40% chance to fire an additional magic orb at a different random enemy target while using the ability "Pippa's Pandemonium".

builderSkills.name: Sands of Time
builderSkills.desc: When this ability is actively used, Prince uses 600 Energy to use the "Ravages of Time", which deals 210% damage to surrounding enemies, also stunning them for 3 seconds. Whenever Prince suffers fatal damage, "Recall" is triggered, and Prince uses 200 Energy to revert his health and position to as they were 8 seconds prior. "Recall" can be triggered up to 1 time per battle.

builderSkills.name: Tempest of Agony
builderSkills.desc: This ability can only be used whenever there is more than 1 enemy in close proximity to Prince. Prince deals 150% damage to nearby enemies, also stunning them for 2 seconds. This ability can be used up to 1 time every 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Wall Dive Attack
builderSkills.desc: This ability can only be used whenever Prince is situated at the edge of the battlefield and an enemy is nearby. When used, Prince pounces from a wall towards an enemy target, dealing damage to all enemies he passes through, which is equal to 9% of their own max health, but shall not exceed 290% of Prince's own Attack Rating. This ability can be used up to 1 time every 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Concentrated Force
builderSkills.desc: Each time an enemy loses a total of 25% of their max health, Prince immediately recovers 40 Energy points, and his Crit Rating is raised by 30% for the next 4 seconds.

sigItem.name: Bounding Agility
sigItem.desc: In between abilities and attacks, Prince will attempt to adjust his position by rolling or somersaulting backwards in order to meet the conditions needed to activate his "Tempest of Agony" and "Wall Dive Attack" abilities. During these actions, Prince's Dodge is raised by 100 points, and once the actions have finished, Prince's Attack Rating will be increased by 20% for 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Lightning Purge
builderSkills.desc: Zaphrael teleports to the side of the battlefield which has the most enemies on it and fires 7 powerful bolts of lightning across the battlefield, dealing 180% damage per lightning bolt to each enemy that the bolts strike.

builderSkills.name: Thunderstorm
builderSkills.desc: Zaphrael summons a thundercloud that exists for 18 seconds which strikes the enemy target nearest to Zaphrael every 4 seconds, dealing 150% damage to them and also causing them to be temporarily stunned.

builderSkills.name: Lightning Arc
builderSkills.desc: Zaphrael teleports behind the enemy that is closest to his allies' side of the battlefield and knocks them to the ground, dealing 230% AoE damage to the target and nearby enemies. Simultaneously, Zaphrael receives a shield that is able to mitigate damage equal to 500% of his own Attack Rating, which has duration of 8 seconds. While the shield exists, Zaphrael uses melee attacks and once the shield disappears, Zaphrael shall immediately return to his original position.

builderSkills.name: Static Charge
builderSkills.desc: During battle, enemies damaged by Zaphrael will be electrified for 10 seconds. When electrified enemies are dealt damage that exceeds 12% of their max health, the electric shall be transferred to the next closest enemy, causing the nearby enemy to lose health that is equal to 30% of the initial attack's damage.

sigItem.name: Zeal
sigItem.desc: After using the ability "Lightning Arc" Zaphrael's Normal Melee Attacks become even more powerful, dealing 60% damage 9 times to the enemy, also interrupting their current action.

builderSkills.name: Ginnungagap
builderSkills.desc: Albedo instantly teleports to the most densely populated area of enemies and deals 300% AoE damage to nearby enemies. 45% of the total damage dealt to her enemies is converted into a shield, which has a duration of 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Black Guard
builderSkills.desc: Albedo gains a shield with a value equal to 220% of her Attack Rating, after which she teleports next to the backline ally with the lowest HP and protects them for 5 seconds. While the shield exists, both Albedo and that ally are immune to control abilities, and Albedo shall bear all of the damage intended for that ally. If the hero Ainz Ooal Gown is an ally, Albedo will prioritize him with this ability above all other allies.

builderSkills.name: Shield Lord
builderSkills.desc: Albedo teleports next to a random ally that is currently near an enemy and deals 220% damage to the enemy, stunning them for 4 seconds. If the hero Ainz Ooal Gown is an ally, Albedo will prioritize him with this ability above all other allies.

builderSkills.name: Hermes Trismegistus
builderSkills.desc: During battle, Albedo's Crit Damage Resistance is increased by 35 points. If Albedo is dealt a Critical Strike, the attacker's Attack Rating is reduced by 30% for 5 seconds. This ability cannot be stacked.

sigItem.name: Guardian Overseer
sigItem.desc: During battle, the Defense Ratings of all Dimensional heroes are increased by 15% for every Dimensional hero that is in the allied formation. The effects of this ability can be stacked up to 2 times.

builderSkills.name: Fallen Down
builderSkills.desc: Ainz begins a chant which lasts for 5 seconds, after which 460% damage is dealt to all enemy targets. If his chant is interrupted, Ainz will recover 500 Energy points.

builderSkills.name: Magic Caster
builderSkills.desc: Ainz' Normal Attacks are changed to the following abilities, which are used in a cycle:Call Greater Thunder: Deals 240% damage to the enemy target.Gravity Maelstrom: Deals 210% damage to the enemy and any other nearby enemy targets.True Dark: Deals 180% damage to the enemy target and prevents the enemy from using their Ultimate ability for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: The Goal of All Life is Death
builderSkills.desc: After 24 seconds of battle, all enemies lose 30% of their current health and are stunned for 4 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Steady Preparations
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battle Ainz receives a shield equal to 40% of his max health, which lasts for 6 seconds. While the shield exists, Ainz is immune to control abilities and continues to chant, gaining 70 Energy points and a permanent +4% Attack Rating and +8% Defense Rating attribute increase per second. Once the shield disappears, Ainz ceases chanting.

sigItem.name: Cash Items
sigItem.desc: The chanting phase of the Ultimate ability "Fallen Down" is omitted the first time it is used.

builderSkills.name: Empowerment
builderSkills.desc: Mortas grants the allied target with the highest Attack Rating 25% of the target's own Attack Rating and 25 Attack Speed points as well as the effects of the ability "Greed" up until the end of battle.

builderSkills.name: Greed
builderSkills.desc: This is a passive ability that allows for Mortas' Normal Attacks to steal 4% of an enemy's current health and 10% of their current shield value. Each enemy may only be affected by this ability once every 1.5 seconds. The amount of health stolen from an enemy cannot exceed 220% of Mortas' own Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Blood Pact
builderSkills.desc: Mortas consumes 10% of his current health to heal the most injured non-summoned ally for 2 times worth the amount of the health which was consumed.

builderSkills.name: Devilish Deal
builderSkills.desc: Mortas allows the enemy that has regenerated the highest amount of health to instantly recover 15% of their max health, however, for the following 15 seconds, all of the health regenerated by the enemy is transferred to Mortas.

sigItem.name: Trickery
sigItem.desc: When a Normal Attack deals a Critical Strike, another enemy is additionally struck, however, the damage dealt is reduced by 70% and the additional attack does not trigger any effects.

builderSkills.name: Stationary Drifter
builderSkills.desc: QUEEN summons Johanna and rides it, spinning around at highspeed to generate a Nuclear Tornado. The tornado sucks enemies in towards its center, dealing 60% AoE damage 7 times with a final attack which deals 200% AoE damage. QUEEN cannot be attacked while the effects of her Ultimate ability occurring.

builderSkills.name: Freidyne
builderSkills.desc: QUEEN summons Johanna which deals 250% AoE damage to all enemies in front of it and also generates a nuclear effect which lasts for 5 seconds. If an enemy suffers 2 Critical Strikes, while the effect is active, they shall be stunned for 2 seconds. Enemies can be stunned multiple times while the nuclear effect is occurring.

builderSkills.name: Attack & Defend
builderSkills.desc: QUEEN's Crit Rating is increased by 6% and her Defense Rating is increased by 20% every 10 seconds. This ability can be stacked.

builderSkills.name: Ms. Post-Apocalyptic Raider
builderSkills.desc: QUEEN deals a 4 hit combo, with each hit dealing 160% damage to an enemy target, and on the final hit summons Johanna, which knocks nearby enemies backwards and causes them to be stunned for 3 seconds.

sigItem.name: Edge of Death
sigItem.desc: QUEEN is granted a shield which exists for 5 seconds and has a value equal to 25% of her max health every time Johanna is summoned by any of her abilities.

builderSkills.name: Maeigaon
builderSkills.desc: Summons Arsène who deals 260% damage to all enemy targets.

builderSkills.name: Adverse Reaction
builderSkills.desc: JOKER chooses the enemy that is positioned directly opposite himself at the start of battles as his Combat Target (CT). If the CT belongs to a non-Dimensional faction, JOKER will temporarily change factions in order to gain a factional damage bonus against the CT but will also suffer from its adverse effects. When JOKER's abilities deal damage to an enemy of whom he has a factional advantage against, the enemy will be knocked down for 2 seconds and then weakened. Weakened enemies receive 30% more damage over 5 seconds. Knock-down and weakening effects may only be used once every 7 seconds against the same target. If the CT is slain, JOKER will choose the enemy with the highest Combat Rating as his next CT.

builderSkills.name: Concentrated Fire
builderSkills.desc: Each time JOKER has used his Normal Attack 4 times, he will use his gun to deal 180% damage to his Combat Target.

builderSkills.name: All-Out Attack
builderSkills.desc: When 3 or more enemies, or all enemies are controlled, All-Out Attack is triggered, dealing 300% damage to all enemies. This ability can only be used when there are surviving allies on the battlefield. This ability can be triggered once every 7 seconds and can be used up to a maximum of 3 times per battle. The damage caused by this ability will not trigger the effects of "Adverse Reaction".

sigItem.name: Widespread Attack
sigItem.desc: After JOKER uses his Ultimate ability, the AoE range of his Normal Attacks is increased for 7 seconds, during which time he deals 20% additional damage.

builderSkills.name: Winter War Cry
builderSkills.desc: Passive: All characters on the battle (including allies) have their Haste reduced by 40 points.Active: Alna calls down a blizzard upon all enemies, dealing 340% damage to them, causing any Haste reductions to be multiplied by 2 times over 12 seconds, also nullifying any Haste buffs that are received during this time. The effects of this ability cannot be affected by any other abilities.

builderSkills.name: Freezing Pierce
builderSkills.desc: Alna thrusts her spear into an enemy target, dealing damage equal to 10% of their max health. Damage dealt cannot exceed 520% of Alna's own Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Frozen Fury
builderSkills.desc: Alna uses her spear to swipe at nearby enemies, dealing 200% damage to them, also reducing their Haste by 20 points for 5 seconds. Each use of this ability increases the number of attacks that are dealt, up until a maximum of 3 attacks are reached. This ability's Haste reduction effect may be stacked multiple times.

sigItem.name: Unrelenting Heart
sigItem.desc: During battles, when Alna suffers damage, she gradually recovers 50% of the health which was lost over the next 15 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Bomb Voyage
builderSkills.desc: Kren returns to the allied side of the battlefield to set "Hot Stuff" down on the ground and fires 1 shell every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds instead of using his Normal Attack. Each shell deals 180% AoE damage to enemies. During the shelling period, Kren cannot move, be knocked back or knocked into the air. Shelling shall cease if there are no enemies on the enemy side of the battlefield.

builderSkills.name: Enshrouding Bomb
builderSkills.desc: Kren lobs a smoke bomb at the allied hero which is farthest forward, enshrouding them in smoke for 8 seconds. Allies enshrouded by the smoke cannot be dealt Critical Strikes and have their own Crit Ratings increased by 25 points.

builderSkills.name: Old Pal
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of battle Kren fires a flare into the sky, calling in a friend of his who sets down 5 landmines behind the enemy formation, at the edge of the battlefield. If an enemy steps on a landmine it will explode, dealing 300% AoE damage, also stunning enemies for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Concussive Blast
builderSkills.desc: Kren charges towards the enemy that is nearest to the allied side of the battlefield and uses "Lady" to attack them. This attack deals 240% damage to the target and sends them hurtling backwards, Kren is also knocked backwards as a result of "Lady's" force.

sigItem.name: Potent Firepower
sigItem.desc: After using 3 regular Normal Attacks, Normal Attacks are enhanced once. Enhanced Normal Attacks deal an additional 40% damage to enemies, and also knock them backwards, stunning them for 1 second.

builderSkills.name: Wind Spiral
builderSkills.desc: Respen manifests a Wind Swallow every 3 seconds, which encircle himself up until 5 Swallows exist. Active: Using his Ultimate ability, Respen sends the enemy with the highest Attack Rating hurtling into the air , dealing 250% damage to them, also stunning them for 3 seconds . All Wind Swallows manifested by Respen currently on the battlefield will then respectively deal an additional 90% damage to the enemy.

builderSkills.name: Feathered Fury
