Each stack of Faith increases the Attack Rating and Defense Rating of nearby allied heroes by 3% and 3% of Palmer's initial Attack Rating and Defense Rating, respectively.The prayer ends when Palmer's Faith reaches the max number of stacks, the total damage he receives exceeds 60% of his max health, or there are no other surviving allied heroes left. After his first prayer ends, the attribute buffs will apply to all allied heroes.

builderSkills.name: Divine Defense
builderSkills.desc: Passive. During battle, if there are at least 2 surviving allied heroes, the damage received by the allied hero with the lowest health will be reduced by 40%. The reduction in damage will be distributed among the other allied heroes. This damage cannot kill them.Over the next 5 seconds, 60% of the distributed damage will be recovered. The first time an allied hero dies, the other allied heroes will immediately recover all distributed damage, and will receive 30% less damage for the next 5 seconds.

sigItem.name: Exault the Light
sigItem.desc: Once Palmer's Faith is maxed out, he will increase the Crit Rating of all allied heroes by 10 plus 40% of his base Crit Rating.

builderSkills.name: Warmonger
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Veithael gains 50 Energy per second if he is not being controlled, but loses 150 Energy per second if he is being controlled.Active: Veithael spends 300 Energy to swing his sword, damaging nearby enemies for 340% of his Attack Rating. After using this skill, every subsequent time Veithael uses a skill, he will spend 350 Energy to trigger an Energy Burst, damaging all enemies in front of him for 10% of his max health. Energy burst damage cannot exceed 500% of his Attack Rating. When Veithael's Energy falls below 350, he will stop triggering Energy Bursts until he uses this skill again. Veithael will not use this skill while an Energy Burst can still be triggered.

builderSkills.name: Brutal Backswing
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Veithael's max health is increased by 30% at the start of the battle. His health percentage remains unchanged. When Veithael takes damage, it will reduce his max health until it reaches its original value.Active: Veithael charges forward, damaging enemies for 240% of his Attack Rating and knocking them back. He then returns and swings his sword, which damages enemies for 320% of his Attack Rating, stuns them for 1 second, and heals Veithael for 25% of his max health. For the duration of this skill, Veithael receives 40% less damage. If this skill triggers an Energy Burst, enemies will be stunned for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Hear No Evil
builderSkills.desc: If Veithael is about to be inflicted with a control effect, he negates the effect and swings his sword, damaging nearby enemies for 260% of his Attack Rating and interrupting their casting. For each enemy hit, Veithael is healed for 100% of his Attack Rating. This skill can only be triggered once every 15 seconds. If this skill triggers an Energy Burst, enemies hit by the Energy Burst permanently lose 3 points of Insight and 3 points of Proficiency.

builderSkills.name: Head Held High
builderSkills.desc: Active: Head Held High is considered a Normal Attack for Veithael. When used, it damages enemies in front of him 2 times for 140% of his Attack Rating. If this skill triggers an Energy Burst, the Energy Burst deals additional damage equal to 10% of Veithael's max health.Passive: Each time Veithael deals damage, he gains 1% Attack Rating (stacks up to 20 times). At max stacks, Veithael gains 25 Physical Pierce. If Veithael is being controlled, he will lose his Attack Rating and Physical Pierce buffs.

sigItem.name: Godly Physique
sigItem.desc: The max health bonus Veithael receives at the start of battle is increased to 50%. His health percentage remains unchanged.

builderSkills.name: Flashing Steel
builderSkills.desc: Mulan slashes repeatedly with her sword, damaging enemies in front of her 2 times for 200% of her Attack Rating. She then teleports and unleashes another flurry of slashes, damaging enemies in front of her 3 times for 200% of her Attack Rating.While using this skill, Mulan is immune to direct damage and control effects, but the amount of damage negated will be recorded. After the skill ends, she will lose health equal to 80% of the negated damage. This damage cannot kill her.

builderSkills.name: Formidable Fortress
builderSkills.desc: Active: Mulan fly-kicks enemies in front of her, damaging them for 280% of her Attack Rating and knocking them airborne.Passive: If Mulan is about to receive damage that exceeds 10% of her max health or would reduce her to less than 10% health, she will parry the attack with her sword and damage enemies in front of her for 200% of her Attack Rating. Parrying reduces the damage she takes by 50%. She can parry 4 times over the next 3 seconds, after which the colldown for this skill's active effect will be reset and Mulan will be unable to parry again for the next 12 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Relentless Pursuit
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Whenever Mulan knocks an enemy hero airborne, she hits them with a follow-up attack, damaging them for 100% of her Attack Rating. Each follow-up attack increases the damage of the next follow-up attack by 20% of Mulan's Attack Rating, up to 300%. If the target is a Boss, Mulan will still launch a follow-up attack even if she fails to knock them airborne.

sigItem.name: Defense to Offense
sigItem.desc: If Mulan parries a skill, any subsequent damage it deals to her will be reduced by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

builderSkills.name: Divine Light
builderSkills.desc: Belinda uses her divine power to attack a large area of enemies 4 times. Each successful hit deals 110% Magic Damage to the enemy targets.

builderSkills.name: Divine Retribution
builderSkills.desc: Belinda fires an orb of divine energy towards her enemies. The ball explodes on impact with the first enemy it reaches. Surrounding enemies consequently suffer 160% damage.

builderSkills.name: Brilliance
builderSkills.desc: Belinda's Crit Rating is increased by 12%.

builderSkills.name: Blessing
builderSkills.desc: Belinda blesses the ally with the highest Attack Rating, raising their Attack Rating by 15% and Crit Rating by 15%.

sigItem.name: Gift of Heaven
sigItem.desc: All allies that are receiving the effects of the ability "Blessing" will have a 40% chance to activate the "Divine Retribution" ability. This ability can be activated up to 3 times every 5 seconds. Damage dealt by this ability is equal to 40% of the ability's original damage when used by allies.

builderSkills.name: Painwheel
builderSkills.desc: Tamrus spins around violently 1 times. Each spin damages nearby enemeis for 220% of his Attack Rating, stuns them, and drags them towards Tamrus. Tamrus spins 1 more time (up to 4 times) for every 1 enemy within range. The range of his spins increases with each spin.When he stops spinning, he forcefully kicks nearby targets, damaging them for 260% of his Attack Rating. Tamrus is immune to control effects while using this skill.

builderSkills.name: Earth Breaker
builderSkills.desc: Tamrus leaps high into the air then dive-kicks the area with the most enemy heroes, damaging all enemies in the area for 200% of his Attack Rating and knocking them airborne. Tamrus is immune to control effects while using this skill.

builderSkills.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
builderSkills.desc: The more enemy heroes around Tamrus, the more excited he becomes. For every 1 enemy heroes near him, Tamrus gains 1 stack of the Enthusiasm effect (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Enthusiasm increases his Dodge by 6 points and his Magic Suppression by 2 points.

builderSkills.name: Get Over Here
builderSkills.desc: Tamrus flings his grappling hook at up to 2 enemies, damaging them for 230% of his Attack Rating and dragging them towards himself. Enemies furthest away from Tamrus are targeted first. Hooked enemies have their Attack Rating reduced by 10% for 5 seconds. If there is only 1 target, the damage is increased to 250% of Tamrus' Attack Rating and the target's Attack Rating is reduced by 15%.

sigItem.name: Jungle Jaunt
sigItem.desc: Enemy heroes hit by "Get Over Here" have their Tenacity permanently reduced by 3 points. This effect can stack.

builderSkills.name: Infernal Bombardment
builderSkills.desc: Olgath leaps into the air with Dealth Knell and fires an infernal shot at each enemy in turn, until all enemies have taken damage from this skill 1 time or there are no more targetable enemies. Olgath will fire at least 5 and at most 10 infernal shots each time this skill is used. He is invincible when firing.Infernal shots consume 1 loaded shell of each type, which will be fused together and fired at the target, dealing AoE damage equal to 250% of Olgath's Attack Rating and triggering the effects of the consumed shells. If no shells are consumed, only the AoE damage will be dealt.

builderSkills.name: Slotted Shell
builderSkills.desc: Olgath creates a ball of Scatter Shells, Shrapnel Shells, and Piercing Shells in that order. He feeds the ball to Death Knell, loading it with 3 shells of that type, then fires 1 infernal shots. Death Knell can store up to 3 shells of each type.When firing an infernal shot, consuming a Scatter Shell greatly increases the AoE of the shot.Consuming a Shrapnel Shell fires 2 extra shots, dealing AoE damage equal to 250% of Olgath's Attack Rating.Consuming a Piercing Shell causes the target to lose additional health equal to 80% of Olgath's Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Fatal Fusillade
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Whenever Olgath hits with a normal attack, he loads 1 shell into Death Knell in the order of their creation. If Death Knell is already loaded with all shell types when Olgath hits a normal attack, that normal attack will be upgraded into an infernal shot. This effect can only trigger once every 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Cataclysmic Roar
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Whenever Olgath receives melee damage exceeding 10% of his current health, Death Knell will roar 3 times. Each roar will stun nearby enemies for a short time and knock them back. This effect can only trigger once every 15 seconds.

sigItem.name: Deadly Discernment
sigItem.desc: If Infernal Bombardment has hit all targetable enemies enough times to stop the bombardment, it will prioritize targets with the lowest current health.

builderSkills.name: Liege Lord
builderSkills.desc: Passive: At the start of battle, Edwin creates a Dominion that follows him around the battlefield. Allied heroes within a Dominion take 70% less normal attack damage.Active: Edwin damages enemies in front of him for 250% of his Attack Rating 4 times. He then creates a large temporary Dominion in the area with the most allied heroes for 12 seconds and damages enemeis within the new Dominion for 300% of his Attack Rating. This temporary Dominion has the same effect as the regular Dominion, but their effects do not stack with one another.Edwin is immune to control effects while casting this skill. If this skill is used again while there is already a temporary Dominion on the battlefield, it will be replaced by a new temporary Dominion.

builderSkills.name: Disarming Flurry
builderSkills.desc: Edwin slashes enemies in front of him 3 times. The first two slashes each deal damage for 230% of his Attack Rating. The final slash deals damage for 260% of his Attack Rating.If an enemy is within on if Edwin's Domains, the final slash will also silence them for 2 seconds and reduce their Defense Rating by 30% for 5 seconds.If this skill is interrupted by Rebel's Reprisal before the final slash, the latter skill will also silence and reduce the Defense Rating of enemies within a Dominion in the same manner as the final slash.

builderSkills.name: Royal Favor
builderSkills.desc: Whenever an allied hero within a Dominion takes a single round of damage that exceeds 10% of their max health, the attacker is silenced for 2.5 seconds. This effect can only be triggered up to 1 time every 10 seconds against each attacker.

builderSkills.name: Oathsworn Guardian
builderSkills.desc: Passive: At the start of battle, Crassio will begin protecting the hero positioned below him.Active: If the protected hero is alive and there are enemies around them, Crassio damages all enemies near him for 320% of his Attack Rating, then teleports to the protected hero and damages all enemies near them for 320% of his Attack Rating. Otherwise, Crassio will only slash at the enemies near himself twice, damaging them for 320% of his Attack Rating per slash.

builderSkills.name: Dagger Dash
builderSkills.desc: Crassio targets the enemy hero that has dealt the most damage to his protected hero, marking them as his "Quarry". This skill's effects depend on Crassio's distance from his Quarry.If his Quarry is near him, he slashes twice, damaging all enemies near him for 250% of his Attack Rating per slash.If his Quarry is far away, he throws a dagger at them, damaging all enemies near the Quarry for 250% of Crassio's Attack Rating. He then teleports to catch the dagger, damaging all nearby enemies for 250% of his Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Lethal Deflection
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Whenever Crassio or his protected hero take a single round of damage exceeding 20% of Crassio's max health, he reduces the damage by 50% then damages the attacker and all enemies near them for 200% of his Attack Rating. This effect can trigger up to 3 times.Active: Crassio inflicts damage for 200% of his Attack Rating on enemies in front. If there are passive triggers remaining, the enemies will be dealt damage for 200% of Crassio's Attack Rating equivalent to the remaining passive triggers. After "Lethal Deflection" is cast, the number of passive triggers is refreshed.

builderSkills.name: Repelling Smash
builderSkills.desc: Passive. When the target for protection is attacked at close quarters, Crassio teleports back to the target's side, dealing damage for 240% of his Attack Rating to surrounding enemies and knocking them back, while granting the target a shield worth 280% of his Attack Rating that lasts for 6 seconds. This skill can trigger up to 1 time every 12 seconds. After this skill is used, the cooldown of "Dagger Dash" is refreshed immediately.

sigItem.name: Vengeance
sigItem.desc: Every 10 times Crassio deals damage to his Quarry, he gains 5 points of Crit Rating and 5 points of Tenacity until the end of battle. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

builderSkills.name: Essence of the Spiritual Arts User
builderSkills.desc: Emilia cannot gain Energy by attacking, getting attacked, or through any other method. She starts the battle with 1000 Energy and will immediately cast her Ultimate to summon Puck to assist her. Using her Ultimate skill does not cost Energy, but while Puck is present, Emilia will lose 100 Energy per second. When her Energy reaches 0, Puck goes to sleep.While Puck is summoned, it will continuously fire ice crystals at the area with the most enemies, dealing damage equal to 350% of Emilia's Attack Rating to all targets and inflicting the Frost effect on them for 6 seconds. Each time a target with the Frost effect takes damage, they will take extra damage equal to 350% of Emilia's Attack Rating. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once every 2 seconds.While Puck is asleep, Emilia recovers 150 Energy every time an allied hero uses their Ultimate, until she uses her Ultimate to summon Puck again.

builderSkills.name: Ice Flower
builderSkills.desc: Emilia calls upon the mana in the air and freezes all enemies for 0.5 to 1.5 seconds. The lower the current health of an enemy, the longer they will be frozen for.

sigItem.name: Ice User
sigItem.desc: The Defense Rating of frozen enemies is reduced by 20%.

builderSkills.name: Demon Form
builderSkills.desc: Rem enters her demon form for 8 seconds (she will not exit demon form while other skills are being used) and swings her Morning Star multiple times, damaging nearby enemies for 200% of her Attack Rating per hit. In demon form, Rem deals 20% more damage and drains 10 Energy from all enemy heroes every 2 seconds. If Rem uses her Ultimate while already in demon form, the duration of her demon form will be reset, and the effect of her current Morning Star swings will be enhanced, dealing damage multiple times each equal to 250% of her Attack Rating and knocking targets airborne.

builderSkills.name: Morning Star Swing
builderSkills.desc: Rem uses her Morning Star to smash the enemy hero who has dealt the highest total damage, damaging the enemy for 200% of her Attack Rating, knocking them back, and reducing their Energy by 250 points. If the enemy is knocked to the edge of the battlefield, they will take additional damage equal to 150% of her Attack Rating and be stunned for 1 second.

builderSkills.name: Healing Mana
builderSkills.desc: Rem uses healing mana to heal the allied hero with the lowest health for 10% of their max health. The allied hero also receives a shield worth 300% of Rem's Attack Rating. The healing mana's effects linger for 4 seconds, increasing the healing that the ally receives by 20 points and healing them for 40% of Rem's Attack Rating every second.

builderSkills.name: Demon Tribe
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Rem's Attack Rating permanently increases the more her allies take damage. For every 1% of their max health an ally loses, Rem's Attack Rating is increased by 2% (up to 200% of Rem's initial Attack Rating).

sigItem.name: The Demon Survivor
sigItem.desc: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is increased by 10%.

builderSkills.name: Divine Fury
builderSkills.desc: Athalia attacks her enemies with lightning speed and precision, slashing them 3 times from various positions on the battlefield. Each slash deals 160% damage to all enemies in her path. The third slash has a 100% critical strike chance.

builderSkills.name: Judgement
builderSkills.desc: Athalia descends from the heavens onto the battlefield and targets the enemy directly opposite her, inflicting 280% damage on them. Once the initial attack has finished, Athalia will stand and attack the targeted enemy normally. Enemies will not be able to regenerate Energy when attacked by this ability.

builderSkills.name: Purging Frenzy
builderSkills.desc: Athalia unleashes a multi-staged attack on the enemy nearest to her, with the final blow dealing 150% damage to the target that also leaves them stunned for 2 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Protection
builderSkills.desc: Athalia uses a divine aura that allows herself to mitigate 8% of all received damage for every ally still alive on the battlefield.

sigItem.name: Bloodless
sigItem.desc: Defense Rating is increased by 4% of the value of Athalia's Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Leaden Smash
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Ginneas' Burst Hammer can hold up to 6 shells. At the start of battle, it has 3 shells. If there are shells remaining when Ginneas deals damage with his skill, 1 shell will be consumed to increase this damage by 60% of his Attack Rating.Active: Ginneas loads his Burst Hammer with shells, lifts it high, then swings it at the ground, dealing AoE damage 3 times, each time extending to a wider range. This knocks enemies into the air and stuns them briefly. The damage dealt for each time is 230%, 280%, and 330% of Ginneas' Attack Rating respectively. Ginneas is immune to control effects while using this skill.

builderSkills.name: Hefty Strike
builderSkills.desc: Ginneas smashes enemies within a certain range in front of him with his Burst Hammer, dealing damage equal to 250% of his Attack Rating and reducing enemies' Haste by 40 points, for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Crushing Mockery
builderSkills.desc: Ginneas charges to the side of the enemy hero who has dealt the highest damage. After dealing damage once for 200% of his Attack Rating, he loads shells and taunts nearby enemies for 6 seconds. While taunting, Ginneas is immune to control effects and receives 50% less damage. After the taunt ends, 100% of the damage reduced during the taunt is converted into Fearless Shields to be distributed to all allies, with the shields lasting 7 seconds. The minimum and maximum value of the shield shall be 10% and 25% of Ginneas' max health respectively. Ginneas also knocks nearby enemies airborne and deals damage equal to 200% of Ginneas' Attack Rating. If he is using another skill when the taunt ends, he distributes shields after the skill ends and deals damage.

builderSkills.name: Meteor Supernova
builderSkills.desc: Ginneas swings his Burst Hammer, dealing damage to enemies in front of him twice, each time for 220% of his Attack Rating. If shells are consumed for the first damage and the enemy's remaining shield value is lower than 1000% of Ginneas' Attack Rating, he destroys the enemy's shield and grants himself a Fearless Shield with a value equal to 50% of the destroyed shield's value, up to 20% of his max ehalth, for 7 seconds. If shells are consumed for the second damage, Ginneas knocks the enemy airborne and stuns them for 2 seconds.

sigItem.name: Overload
sigItem.desc: Each time shells are consumed, the damage dealt this time is increased by 80% of Ginneas' Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Floral Shade
builderSkills.desc: Daemia creates Lush Shade for 10 seconds and dispels most of the negative effects suffered by all allies and enemies. During this time, they are unable to recover health, damage dealt is increased by 100%, and health cannot become less than 20% from direct damage. These effects do not work on Bosses.After Lush Shade ends, Daemia removes her control effects and swings her staff to deal damage for 300% of her Attack Rating to all enemies. After Lush shade has ended for 5 seconds, Daemia can use her Ultimate once again.

builderSkills.name: Days of Bloom
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Every 8 seconds, Demia grants Dewy Nectra to allied heroes within her half of the battlefield for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be stacked.Active: Daemia unleashes a flurry of petaals, dealing damage for 200% of Daaemia's Attack Rating to all enemies. If used actively when Lush Shade is active, this skill additionally restores 200 Energy points for heroes possessing Dewy Nectar.

builderSkills.name: Scorching Monsoon
builderSkills.desc: Creates Torrid Wind that lasts for 10 seconds. While Torrid Wind is active, each time an enemy takes damage increases the damage it suffers subsequently by 3%. This effect can be stacked up to 8 times until Torrid Wind ends, and cannot be dispelled. This skill will not be used agin if Torrid Wind is present on the battlefield.

builderSkills.name: Sweltering Heat
builderSkills.desc: Daemia creates Blazing Sun that lasts for 10 seconds. While Blazing Sun is active, each time an enemy deals damage reduces their damage output by 3%. This effect can be stacked up to 8 times, and lasts until Blazing Sun ends. This effect cannot be dispelled. This skill will not be used again if Blazing Sun is present on the battlefield.

sigItem.name: Sultry Season
sigItem.desc: Once allied have received Dewy Nectar a cumulative 2 times, their Attack Rating is permanently increased by 15% points.

builderSkills.name: Stellar Guide
builderSkills.desc: Passive: Trishea observes the universe and changes her Normal Attack according to the guidance of the stars, in the form of either Luminance or Eclipse. After following the guidance, she receives 1 Feather of Fate.Luminance: Deals small AoE damage to all enemy heroes for 100% of Trishea's Attack Rating.Eclipse: Deals damage to the enemy hero with the highest health for 300% of Trishea's Attack Rating.Active: When using the skill, her feathers float and form a Glittering Arc, dealing damage for 300% of her Attack Rating to enemies on the path. To use her Ultimate skill, Trishea requires 7 feathers but does not consume Energy.Trishea cannot receive Energy when her skill, Starlight Plumes, is still locked.

builderSkills.name: Starlight Plumes
builderSkills.desc: Trishea recovers Energy but at an Energy Recovery that is reduced by 90%. The Energy she receives each time does not exceed 50 points. For every 200 Energy points possessed, she gains 2 points of Magic Pierce.

builderSkills.name: Destiny Teller
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Trishea's outcome from observing the universe and receiving guidance becomes more stable. The more surviving enemy heroes, the more likely the guidance will be Luminance, and when there are 5 surviving enemy heroes, the chances of receiving Luminance are 100%. The fewer surviving enemy heroes, the more likely the guidance will be Eclipse, and when tehre is only 1 surviving enemy hero, the chances of receiving Eclipse are 100%.

builderSkills.name: Astral Mystery
builderSkills.desc: Passive. Each feather received by Trishea causes her Ultimate skill, Stellar Guide, to deal additional effects to enemies: each feather received after Eclipse increases damage taken by the target by 5% for 6 seconds; each feather received after Luminance deals additional health loss to the target for 30% of Trishea's Attack Rating. After she uses her Ultimate skill, Stellar Guide, the additional effect will be reset.

sigItem.name: Cosmic Revelation
sigItem.desc: While observing the universe, Trishea is immune to control effects.

builderSkills.name: Falling Sun
builderSkills.desc: Safiya focuses her energy into a large, powerful orb that deals AoE damage on impact. Depending on how long Safiya focuses her energy, the orb can deal from 100% damage up to 540% damage, with the area of effect also increasing in radius. Pressing Safiya's portrait initiates the focusing stage of the ability, pressing the portrait once more releases the orb.

builderSkills.name: Scattered Bolt
builderSkills.desc: Safiya fires a magic projectile at an enemy target which deals 170% damage and stuns them for a short time. After impacting the first enemy target, the projectile splits into 2 small and weaker projectiles that target other nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Static Field
builderSkills.desc: Safiya provides the most forward positioned ally with an electric aura that lasts for 10 seconds. The electric aura causes 70% damage per second to every enemy standing within its radius.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Disruption
builderSkills.desc: At the beginning of the battle Safiya casts a circular enchantment over backline allies that lasts for 25 seconds. All allies standing within the circle have their Attack Ratings increased by 16% and any enemies standing within the circle have their Attack Ratings reduced by 50% as well as their haste reduced.

sigItem.name: Arcane Power
sigItem.desc: 1% of Safiya's total damage output is converted into her Attack Rating. The Attack Rating can be increased up to a total of 140%.

builderSkills.name: Star Shot
builderSkills.desc: Lyca shoots an arrow that deals 220% damage to all enemy targets which it passes through, knocking them backwards in the process.

builderSkills.name: Rapid Arrows
builderSkills.desc: Lyca shoots off 3 arrows in quick succession, with each arrow dealing 120% damage to the enemy target.

builderSkills.name: Awe
builderSkills.desc: Lyca bounds onto the battlefield at the beginning of battles and inspires her allies, increasing their Haste by 35 points for 8 seconds.

sigItem.name: Vision of the Stars
sigItem.desc: Increases all allies' accuracy by 40 while Lyca is alive.

builderSkills.name: Tortured Souls
builderSkills.desc: Souls of the dead spiral around Shemira causing continuous damage to nearby enemies over a duration of 12 seconds. 50% of all damage caused by this ability will be converted into health that heals Shemira.

builderSkills.name: Soul Siphon
builderSkills.desc: Shemira continuously leeches an enemy's life to restore her own which deals 45% damage every 0.5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Silence
builderSkills.desc: Shemira deals 100% damage to a magic based enemy and simultaneously prevents them from casting any abilities for several seconds.

builderSkills.name: Wrath
builderSkills.desc: Shemira deals more damage the more health she possesses. Shemira's damage can be increased by up to 30%.

sigItem.name: Twisted Torture
sigItem.desc: The "Tortured Souls" ability deals 12% extra damage when there is 1 enemy on the battlefield, 6% when there are 2 enemies on the battlefield, and 3% damage when there are 3 enemies on the battlefield.

builderSkills.name: Divine Strike
builderSkills.desc: Lucius smashes the ground with his warhammer that causes a shockwave, knocking nearby enemies over, while also dealing 130% AoE damage to them.

builderSkills.name: Divine Blessing
builderSkills.desc: Lucius heals the ally with the lowest health for 200% of his own Attack Rating and raises their Defense Rating for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Blessed Shield
builderSkills.desc: Lucius creates a blessed shield that is able to reduce 65% of all the damage that he receives for 5 seconds. Lucius will halt his blessed shield if his ultimate ability is available for use. Lucius cannot be controlled by enemies while using this ability.

sigItem.name: Divine Purge
sigItem.desc: Enemy heroes have their Energy recovery effects reduced by 30% for 4 seconds when they are struck by the ability "Divine Strike" or if a Normal Attack becomes a critical strike.

builderSkills.name: Divine Arrow
builderSkills.desc: Gwyneth fires a divine arrow into the sky which splits into multiple arrows that then rain down upon the enemy half of the battlefield, dealing 210% damage to any enemies that are struck while also reducing their Accuracy by 90 for 8 seconds. This ability cannot be activated if the enemy side of the battlefield is empty.

builderSkills.name: Flaming Arrows
builderSkills.desc: Gwyneth's Normal Attacks will prioritize the enemy directly opposite her current position. Her Normal Attacks deal high damage but have a low attack frequency. Gwyneth's Normal Attacks have a 60% chance to become flaming arrows. Gwyneth's flaming arrows deal 220% damage to enemies on impact and cause them to burn for 5 seconds, dealing 40% damage per second.

builderSkills.name: Lightning Arrows
builderSkills.desc: Normal Attacks have a 60% chance to become lightning arrows that can damage multiple nearby enemies for 220% damage with chain lightning. Lightning arrows can also be combined with flaming arrows, allowing for the burning effect of the "Flaming Arrow" skill to also affect multiple nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Strength In Numbers
builderSkills.desc: Accuracy is raised by 80 and Crit Rating is raised by 25% when there are no enemies in Gwyneth's immediate vicinity.

sigItem.name: Focus Fire
sigItem.desc: Attack Rating is raised to 10% when in close proximity to allied heroes.

builderSkills.name: Fury Strike
builderSkills.desc: Antandra unleashes a multi-stage attack that deals 50% damage with each hit to the enemy which currently has the highest Attack Rating, with the final attack dealing 190% damage to them, also stunning them for 3 seconds. While this ability is in use, Antandra is immune to damage and ignores the enemy's dodges. After successfully striking the enemy with her final attack, Antandra steals 40% of the enemy's Attack Rating and keeps it for 6 seconds. This ability cannot be stacked against a single target more than once, and the amount of Attack Rating stolen cannot exceed 450% of her own Attack Rating value.

builderSkills.name: Mark of the Wild
builderSkills.desc: Antandra attacks an enemy for 220% damage, imprinting her mark upon them for 4 seconds. While marked, the enemy's Accuracy is reduced by 80 and their Energy recovery is reduced by 60%.

builderSkills.name: Piercing Assault
builderSkills.desc: Antandra throws her spear at the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, dealing 180% damage to all enemies it penetrates. Antandra then dashes over to the enemy target, after which she receives a shield which exists for 5 seconds, that has a value equal to 550% of the target Attack Rating, but will not exceed 1000% of her own Attack Rating. Enemies hit by Antandra's spear are marked by Antandra. Antandra cannot be controlled and ignores enemy dodges while this ability is active.

builderSkills.name: Knockdown
builderSkills.desc: Antandra uses her spear to swipe at nearby enemies, dealing 180% damage to them, also knocking them down, meanwhile Antandra recovers 22% of the health she has already lost. Antandra also recovers an additional 8% of her max health for every enemy that she knocks down.

sigItem.name: Unconquerable
sigItem.desc: Allies that strike marked enemies will have their Accuracy increased by 70 points and Crit Rating increased by 15 points for 4 seconds. This ability cannot be stacked.

builderSkills.name: Elemental Surge
builderSkills.desc: Eironn combines both of his blades to form one powerful blade and proceeds to hack at his enemies, dealing 270% damage to them. Eironn then summons an ice tornado which deals AoE damage to enemies and remains on the battlefield for 5 seconds, engulfing multiple enemies, knocking them backwards and slowing their movement speed.

builderSkills.name: Twin Force
builderSkills.desc: When attacking with his ice blade, Eironn deals 150% damage to all enemies standing in front of him and also freezes them, causing their movement and attack speeds to be slowed for 4 seconds. When attacking with his wind blade, Eironn attacks a single enemy target, knocking them backwards, inflicting 180% damage upon them. The wind blade also inflicts additional damage equal to 15% of the enemy target's current health.

builderSkills.name: Vortex
builderSkills.desc: Eironn uses his elemental powers to generate a powerful gust of wind that draws in all enemies standing within a certain range of himself which deals 140% damage to them.

builderSkills.name: Sylvan Oath
builderSkills.desc: Sylvan Oath is a passive ability that increases Eironn's Attack Rating by 15% and gives his attacks a 30% chance to ignore his enemies' Defense Ratings. Any damage dealt to enemies that are using shield abilities is multiplied by 150% times.

sigItem.name: Chill
sigItem.desc: The ability "Elemental Surge" has a chance to cause enemies to become frozen for 2 seconds. The chances of an enemy being frozen are raised if the enemy is already suffering from attack speed reductions, and enemies which are already frozen will no longer be knocked back by the ability.

builderSkills.name: Retaliation
builderSkills.desc: Thoran focuses for several moments before swinging his weapon at all the enemies in front of him, dealing 140% damage to them. 200% of the damage received by Thoran during his focusing stage is dealt back to his enemies as additional damage. While in a focused state, Thoran is immune to control abilities and receives less damage.

builderSkills.name: Domination
builderSkills.desc: Thoran cleaves at an enemy, dealing 120% damage to them, and causes them to fall to the ground.

builderSkills.name: Resurrection
builderSkills.desc: Thoran resurrects himself after dying with 60% of his health restored. This ability can only be used once per battle.

builderSkills.name: Taint
builderSkills.desc: At the start of battle Thoran deals 100% damage to the enemy with the least amount of health, also cursing them. Over the next 15 seconds, if Thoran is dealt damage, the cursed enemy will lose health equal to 70% of the damage value.

builderSkills.name: Joust
builderSkills.desc: Estrilda deals 60% AoE damage 5 times to the enemies standing in front of her, with the final attack dealing 150% damage them, which causes them to be knocked to the ground.

builderSkills.name: Royal Charge
builderSkills.desc: Estrilda charges into her enemies' ranks, knocking down all enemies in her path, dealing 200% damage to them. Estrilda is immune to control abilities while charging.

builderSkills.name: Inspire
builderSkills.desc: Estrilda increases nearby allies' morale by waving her flag in the air, increasing their Attack Rating by 30% for 8 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Ridicule
builderSkills.desc: Estrilda deals 150% damage to an enemy in front, knocking them backwards, and then deals 60% AoE damage to enemies within range, causing their Attack Ratings to be reduced by 14% for 6 seconds.

sigItem.name: In Command
sigItem.desc: When Estrilda is on the frontline and still alive, all damage received by her backline allies is reduced by 5%.

builderSkills.name: Desert Vortex
builderSkills.desc: Skriath summons a sand vortex that appears in the center of the enemy formation which persists for 5 seconds. The vortex has an AoE radius which continuously pulls in enemies, dealing 70% damage per second to all enemies that are trapped in its grasp.

builderSkills.name: Death from Above
builderSkills.desc: Skriath causes large rocks to fall upon an enemy targets's head, dealing 160% AoE damage to them and any nearby enemies.

builderSkills.name: Sandstorm
builderSkills.desc: Skriath creates "Sandstorm" which lasts for 12 seconds. The sandstorm reduces the Accuracy of all enemies by 100 points and Haste by 25 while they are standing within the sandstorm.

builderSkills.name: Critical Insight
builderSkills.desc: Increases allies' Crit Ratings by 0.5 points per second until a maximum of 20 points are reached.

sigItem.name: Boulder Blast
sigItem.desc: Each time Skriath deals a Critical Strike to an enemy target, large rocks fall down on them, dealing 50% AoE damage to them and any nearby enemies. This ability is unable to deal critical damage itself and can only target the same enemy once every 3 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Purification
builderSkills.desc: Fawkes deals 130% damage to all enemies on the battlefield and removes the majority of buffs they may be using.

builderSkills.name: Abate
builderSkills.desc: Fawkes reduces an enemy's attack speed by 35% for 6 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Confine
builderSkills.desc: Fawkes deals 50% damage to the enemy with the highest Attack Rating and then locks them in his coffin for 7 seconds. The affected enemy cannot attack or be attacked while inside the coffin.

builderSkills.name: Silver Bolt
builderSkills.desc: Silver Bolt raises Fawkes' Normal Attack damage by 20% and deals a further additional 40% damage to de-buffed enemies.

sigItem.name: Purged Perseverance
sigItem.desc: Increases the defense ratings of all allied heroes by 5% for 5 seconds if they possess more than 60% of their max energy. Affected allies are also impervious to control abilities.

builderSkills.name: Transmogrification
builderSkills.desc: Pippa deals 270% damage to the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, simultaneously transforming them into an 'Acorn' which is incapable of attacking for 5 seconds. Pippa has a 25% chance of failing to correctly cast this spell. If Pippa fails, the spell's effects shall be cast upon herself.

builderSkills.name: Astral Shift
builderSkills.desc: Pippa teleports the closest enemy target onto the head of the next closest enemy, dealing 290% AoE damage and causing any enemies within range to become stunned for 3 seconds. Pippa has a 90% chance of cast failure on the first cast. If Pippa fails, her closest frontline ally is teleported on to the top of the farthest enemy target's head, but her ally shall not be injured or stunned.

sigItem.name: Pippa Power
sigItem.desc: Every time Pippa fires a magic orb, she has a 40% chance to fire an additional magic orb at a different random enemy target while using the ability "Pippa's Pandemonium".

builderSkills.name: Sanctimony
builderSkills.desc: Eluard immediately creates a Divine Shield that has a value equal to 180% of his max health. If Eluard already possesses a Divine Shield, he consumes it in order to deal damage equal to 20% of the consumed shield's value to all enemies. Damage dealt cannot exceed 500% of Eluard's own Attack Rating.

builderSkills.name: Divine Miracle
builderSkills.desc: Eluard creates a Divine Shield at the beginning of battle that has a value equal to 150% of his max health. When the Divine Shield is broken, Eluard becomes stunned for 8 seconds, after which he creates a new Divine Shield with a value equal to 150% of his max health. Damage dealt to Eluard when not protected by his Divine Shield is equal to 350% of the initial damage.

builderSkills.name: Prayer of Protection
builderSkills.desc: Eluard recites divine scripture, which grants the ally farthest forward on the battlefield immunity from all damage. This ability can be interrupted.

builderSkills.name: Judgement
builderSkills.desc: Eluard recites a scripture of judgment, after which he deals 220% damage to all enemies. Enemies that have slain an allied hero will be dealt 50% more damage for each allied hero they slay. This ability can be interrupted.

sigItem.name: Shield of Faith
sigItem.desc: After the first 2 seconds of battle, the farthest forward ally (excluding Eluard) on the battlefield receives a shield with a value equal to 50% of their own max health, which exists for 5 seconds.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Divergence
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn splits herself into multiple Specters and flies in all directions, during which time she cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' abilities. Each Specter that passes through an enemy inflicts 150% damage upon them. Afterwards, the Specters converge on the weakest enemy target currently on the battlefield after which Theowyn re-manifests herself next to the target. Damage dealt to enemies during the ability's convergence phase is equal to the ability's initial attack damage.

builderSkills.name: Haunting Specter
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn enters spectral form to enshroud an enemy target and, prevent them from recovering any health. While the enemy is enshrouded, Theowyn deals 130% damage per second for a total duration of up to 8 seconds. Once Theowyn has finished enshrouding the enemy, she deals an additional 130% damage to the target. During the enshroud phase, Theowyn cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' abilities.

builderSkills.name: Spectral Curse
builderSkills.desc: Theowyn enters spectral form and charges ahead, cursing every enemy that she passes through, dealing 130% damage to them. If an enemy is already cursed, the curse is removed and Theowyn instead deals damage equal to 15% of the enemy's max health, ignoring all of their defense. Damage dealt cannot exceed 600% of Theowyn's Attack Rating. While in spectral form Theowyn is immune to enemy control abilities.

builderSkills.name: Song of Mourning
builderSkills.desc: Whenever Theowyn receives damage that exceeds 10% of her current health, the exceeding amount of damage shall be reduced by 55%.

sigItem.name: Sorrowful Affliction
sigItem.desc: This ability is activated every 15 seconds of battle. The 1 enemies which have dealt the highest amount of damage to Theowyn within the last 15 seconds shall be afflicted by the effects of Theowyn's "Spectral Curse" ability.
